data.jd_text:
**Summary** 




 The Programme Manager will lead the design, development, and execution of Pearl Initiative’s (PI) Governance in Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Programme. This role will build Pearl Initiative’s thought leadership and impact in strengthening and enabling the MSMEs sector in the GCC region. Programming will especially focus on building the long\-term success and resilience of MSMEs, especially in supply chains, by advancing corporate governance, ethical, strategic, and accountable decision\-making; transparency and disclosure; and innovation. They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 




  





 • Lead the design, development, and execution of the governance in MSMEs programme, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and strategic objectives.
 



 • Continuously innovate and enhance the programme offering, identifying opportunities for improvement and greater impact in MSME governance.
 



 • Develop and implement programme strategies that address emerging trends and challenges faced by MSMEs, ensuring relevance and long\-term sustainability.
 



 • Collaborate with subject matter experts, external consultants, and partners to co\-create high\-quality programme content and deliverables.
 



 • Identify synergies between the programme and other organisational initiatives to drive greater impact across multiple business sectors.
 



 • Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.
 



  





**Business development, community enablement, and financial sustainability** 




  





 • Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.
 



 • Manage an annual market engagement calendar.
 



 • Co\-define funding targets to cover programmatic costs and work towards reserving longer\-term working capital to ensure the financial sustainability of the programme.
 



 • Explore and develop new revenue streams for the programme to diversify funding and enhance financial sustainability.
 



 • Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.
 



 • Represent the organisation by actively participating in relevant events, building new relationships with potential partners and collaborators, and promoting the organisation's programmes.
 



 • Lead the development of compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of programmes to potential funders and partners, highlighting impact, sustainability, and strategic alignment with their objectives.
 



 • Negotiate and finalise funding agreements and partnership contracts.
 



  





**Projects management and contracts compliance** 




  





 • Manage the design, execution, and timely high\-quality delivery of collaborative needs\-based projects and flagship initiatives, focused on research, executive education, capacity\-building, and convenings.
 



 • Adopt best practices in project management across all projects and initiatives, defining clear project scopes, developing detailed project plans, assigning roles and responsibilities, and implementing robust tracking and reporting.
 



 • Manage programme teams and insourced third parties to ensure high accountability, strong performance, and preemptive risk management.
 



 • Oversee the successful execution and delivery of all projects in line with contractual obligations, project timelines, and quality standards.
 



 • Run projects and initiatives with careful cost control and resource allocation to support efforts to achieve financial sustainability with long\-term working capital.
 



 • Proactively communicate project and initiative updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with timely reports on progress, challenges, and successes.
 



  





**Expertise development and thought leadership** 




  





 • Identify, study, and learn from market needs and pain points through research and stakeholder engagement to identify strategic opportunities for impact and growth.
 



 • Lead the development of market\-driven solutions by translating identified market needs and pain points into actionable programme initiatives.
 



 • Curate and convene the programme’s working group, bringing in together working group members and special guests.
 



 • Monitor the market’s offering, notable trends, and any disruptions to consistently strategically position the programme.
 



 • Produce a consistent pipeline of high\-quality, original bi\-lingual content (e.g., op\-eds, articles, blog posts, white papers, research reports, and working group position papers) that showcases expertise and generates meaningful conversations within the industry.
 



 • Build a strong online presence by actively engaging in priority social media channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, industry\-specific forums) to share content, participate in discussions, and network with other thought leaders.
 



 • Cultivate relationships with journalists, analysts, and other industry influencers to amplify thought leadership and reach a wider audience.
 



  





**Team mentorship and development** 




 • Lead, mentor, and develop the programme team members, ensuring ongoing professional growth and skill development.
 



 • Provide regular performance feedback and create growth opportunities for team members, including guidance on career development and training needs.
 



 • Foster an inclusive, collaborative work environment that encourages creativity, continuous learning, and innovation.
 



 • Encourage cross\-team collaboration and facilitate professional development opportunities to enhance team effectiveness and cohesion.
 



 Impact measurement and reporting
 



 • Co\-define quarterly and yearly key impact metrics and engagement KPIs for the programme, ensuring milestones are achievable and validated with feasibility assessments.
 



 • Develop surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance based on impact strategy, methodology, and templates.
 



 • Coordinate data collection of surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance.
 



 • Analyse data of surveys and feedback forms to study and learn from achieved and non\-achieved programmatic impact and performance, based on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs identified in impact strategy.
 



 • Develop an impact baseline assessment for the programme to measure progress towards meeting key market needs and addressing critical market gaps.
 



 • Recommend and implement programmatic improvements, expansions, and other strategic directions from data and insights.
 



 • Prepare impact reports and communicate findings on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs at key programme and project milestones.
 



 • Curate, co\-author, and publish programme specific sections for the annual report.
 



 Tech\-enabled skills development

**Company Description** 
 Warrior Group is a pioneering adventure and experience company redefining how people explore, stay, and connect with nature. We create transformative adventure experiences by combining the power of six specialised divisions: construction, operations, hospitality, consultancy, gear and events. From unique adventure attractions to fully operational destinations, we design, build and manage with passion, purpose and impact.
 



  





 WYLD is a pioneering brand within Warrior Group, redefining adventure\-driven hospitality through an integrated design, build, and operate model. From rugged lodges in mountain escarpments to desert camps and coastal hideaways, WYLD brings together comfort, courage, and connection with nature. Each destination celebrates raw landscapes, authentic adventure experiences, and transformative journeys for discerning travellers.
 



  





 Warrior is seeking a Hospitality Development \& Project Manager to support the growth of the WYLD brand from early\-stage concept development through to project delivery. This is a hybrid role that evolves from strategic development \- supporting feasibility, design, and partnership work \- into hands\-on project management once the first sites are launched.
 











**Role Description:** 
 The Head of Design \& Development is responsible for leading the complete design\-to\-build journey across all WYLD and Warrior Destinations projects. This role oversees the development and execution of architectural, interior design, landscape, and MEP design strategies while ensuring alignment with brand standards, operational requirements, sustainability goals, and construction feasibility.
 



 Acting as the critical link between creative vision and project delivery, the Head of Design \& Development will manage external consultants, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and ensure that all developments are delivered to the highest standards of quality, functionality, and guest experience.
 



  





 ·       Lead the end\-to\-end design and development process across all projects, from concept creation through construction delivery.
 



 ·       Establish and maintain design standards, technical specifications, and brand guidelines to ensure consistency across the portfolio.
 



 ·      Develop project design briefs aligned with business objectives, guest experience requirements, operational needs, and budget parameters.
 



 ·      Manage and coordinate architects, interior designers, landscape architects, MEP consultants, and specialist advisors to deliver integrated design solutions.
 



 ·      Oversee design development, technical reviews, value engineering, and construction documentation to ensure buildability, quality, and cost efficiency.
 



 ·      Act as the primary liaison between design, development, operations, procurement, and construction teams, ensuring effective stakeholder collaboration.
 



 ·      Monitor project execution to safeguard design intent, provide technical guidance, and support successful project delivery.
 



 ·      Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices while driving innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement across all developments.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong Design Management skills, including leading multidisciplinary design teams, managing design workflows, and overseeing projects from concept to delivery.
* Proficiency in Visual Design and Branding, with the ability to establish and maintain cohesive visual identities across destinations and assets.
* Expertise in Product Design for experiences, attractions, or environments, with a focus on user\-centered and commercially viable solutions.
* Experience in Interior Design for hospitality, leisure, or mixed\-use developments, ensuring functional, safe, and immersive spaces.
* Proven background in destination, hospitality, real estate, or themed entertainment development, ideally within the Middle East or similar markets.
* Ability to interpret master plans, architectural drawings, and technical documentation, and to collaborate effectively with architects, engineers, and contractors.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to non\-design audiences.
* Strong project management capabilities, including budgeting, scheduling, risk management, and adherence to regulatory and safety standards.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment and leading teams on multiple concurrent projects.

**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Program Manager for its AMET operations team. The candidate should enjoy getting their hands dirty, and looking around the corners for solutions with the aim of optimization of OTR operations in Amazon’s last mile delivery stations.
   

  

 As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) program manager, you will be the subject matter expert for UTR and OTR operations driving capacity enhancements and utilization improvements in both.
   

  

 You will be a subject matter expert on routing and sortation operations and accountable for RUBL60 and sort grid utilization metrics. You should be able to think big to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes.
   

  

 This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, shipper experience and operator experience; monitor metrics, determine, then drive any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgement and decision\-making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products/programs with little information. He / She will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, business, and operations leaders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As UTR and OTR capacity SME, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Driving (accountable) RUBL60 and Sort Grid utilization metrics across MEATR region.
* Invent solutions to solve complex business problems.
* Provide corresponding tools to support Central Ops.
* Build mechanisms and monitor RUBL60 and Bag utilization metrics on a daily basis. Identify root causes and corrective/preventive actions for misses.
* Discuss trends and unusual behaviors of the RUBL60 and bag utilization metric.
* Provide sustainable solutions and effective guidance across the organization.
* Leverage route planning metrics to define, characterize areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with Tech/Science teams to enhance route planning systems.
* Aim to produce routes that are efficient and maximize the time utilization without impacting drivers' workload.
* Influence Route Planning teams to build models that generate fair, sustainable, and efficient delivery routes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

At Kuehne\+Nagel, our work contributes to more than we imagine.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 Energy Business Development Manager role is one of the most critical commercial positions supporting our Project Logistics strategy. The EBDM reports directly to the Global Head of Project Logistics Energy.No team reports into this position; it is an individual contributor role with significant strategic impact.
   

  

 The EBDM is responsible for generating new business opportunities across all segments of the Oil \& Gas value chain, developing a strong pipeline within defined markets, and analysing market potential and competitive dynamics to prioritize opportunities aligned with strategic goals.
   

  

 Working closely with global and regional stakeholders, the Energy Business Development Manager builds customer relationships based on trust, expertise, and innovation, ensuring the right internal and external partners are engaged at the right time to secure new projects.
   

  

 This role requires a professional who exemplifies strong Compliance and HSE standards, demonstrates strategic thinking, and thrives in a customer‑centric, high‑impact environment.
   

  

**How you create impact**

* Maintain regular communication with key internal stakeholders (Global/National Project Logistics Teams, Tender Management, etc.) and provide updates to senior leadership upon request.
* Demonstrate self\-driven, motivational leadership by communicating clear goals, securing stakeholder buy‑in, and aligning activities with strategic direction.
* Record all opportunities in Corelog and act as a role model for Compliance and HSE standards.
* Foster strong collaboration across Project Logistics Development functions, Operations, Technology, and both Geographic and Technical Leadership teams.
* Drive Gross Profit growth by identifying and securing profitable business opportunities aligned with the Project Logistics Roadmap and strategic objectives.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders, develop business and account plans, and pursue opportunities in alignment with (Key) Account Owners or independently where appropriate.


**What we would like you to bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Proven experience in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Commercial roles within Energy, Oil \& Gas, EPC, or Project Logistics.
* Strong understanding of the Oil \& Gas value chain and major project cycles, including tendering and contract negotiation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex global bids and manage senior‑level customer engagements.
* Strong analytical and strategic planning skills, with the ability to assess markets, build business plans, and prioritize opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across global and matrixed organizations.
* High level of self‑motivation and ownership, with a strong commitment to Compliance and HSE standards; proficiency in CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.


**What's in it for you**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact within Kuehne\+Nagel by shaping major Energy and Project Logistics developments, working in an international and collaborative environment, gaining visibility with global leadership, and benefiting from a culture that values ownership, innovation, and professional growth.
   

  

**Who are we**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary** 




 The Senior Technical Project Manager for Renewables and Batteries will provide and coordinate technical and engineering input into the identification, due diligence, development, and delivery of utility scale renewable energy projects (wind, solar, BESS and hybrid) in feasibility stage, development stage, and tender/bid stage. These technical and engineering inputs will include technology selection, balance of plant design, grid connection works, development of technical documentation to support procurement activities, and overview of installation, construction, commissioning, testing of works, warranty and operational support of existing and new projects.
 



  





  





**Reporting** 




 The Senior Technical Project Manager Renewables will be part of the Engineering and Technical Support (ETS) team for Renewables and Batteries within the GCC and will report to the Head of Engineering MENA.
 



  





  





**Key Accountabilities** 




 • Manage and coordinate engineering work packages with respect to choice of technologies, technical configurations and for setting relevant performance, statutory, safety and quality requirements.
 



 • In charge of all aspects and documentation of the contractual negotiations during Business Development of all O\&M and/or Technical\-related agreements: EPC, EPCM, PPA, OE, LTSA, etc.
 



 • Work closely with the procurement and construction team in line with the procurement strategies and construction strategies.
 



 • Be responsible for drafting/contributing to and negotiating owner specifications, including the incorporation of the latest group experience and standards.
 



 • Prepare Capex and O\&M budgets integrating feedback from Group assets and Group specialists.
 



 • Prepare all O\&M technical related documents for the bid (OM organization chart, O\&M references, O\&M Philosophy, etc.).
 



 • Interface with Lender's Engineer and support Lenders’ due diligence during closing process.
 



 • Management of internal approval process (O\&M and Technical).
 



 • Support of CEO and Construction Managers of Project Companies or CEO and Plant Managers of O\&M Companies, for punctual problems during construction, commissioning phase and during operations.
 



 • Perform technology watch and share knowledge within the ETS team
 



  





  





**Degree / Experience** 




 • Degree in an engineering discipline, bachelors or masters
 



 • Minimum of 15 years of experience in the power generation sector with specific knowledge, expertise and experience in developing or constructing solar PV and/or BESS projects including the ability to:
 



 o evaluate and perform feasibility studies
 



 o conduct technology configurations
 



 o determine construction strategies and operating philosophies
 



 o evaluate yield assessments and conceptual designs
 



 o perform techno\-economic cost analyses for the full lifecycle of a project
 



 o draft, review and negotiate commercial and contractual agreements
 



 o manage and advise transversally on all technical aspects of a project from cradle to grave
 



 • Minimum 10 years of experience in a project management or technical coordination function on solar PV or BESS development or construction projects. Formal training in project management is strongly desirable;
 



 • Knowledge in other renewable technologies such as Wind would be advantageous.
 



 • Knowledge in procurement (e.g. FIDIC) and handling multidisciplinary projects are considered strong assets;
 



 • A basic understanding of HV/MV/LV electrical systems, including international practices on grid connection for centralized energy projects, as well as electrical system integration \& optimization for industrial customers.
 



 • Knowledge and experience working on competitive tenders in the Middle East would be advantageous.
 



  





  





**Behavioral Competencies** 




 • Strong people management skills;
 



 • Flexible, meticulous, good planner, and organizer.
 



 • Ability to work autonomously and be proactive.
 



 • Stress resistant, results\-focused, determined, decisive;
 



 • You think outside the box and dare to challenge the status quo;
 



  





  





**Business Understanding** 




 • Participation on and closing of several utility scale renewable energy projects.
 



 • Development and activities internationally and in MENA in particular.
 



 • Interfaces with Business Development (BD) / Legal / Procurement / Acquisitions, Investments \& Financial Advisory (AIFA) / Construction / Operations.
 



 • O\&M and/or construction knowledge
 



  





  





**Location/travel** 




 Dubai Office with travel in GCC plus episodic travels inside and outside the MENA region.
 



 • Flexibility to travel in the AMEA region if needed.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
   

  

 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
   

  

 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

Messe Frankfurt Middle East is a trusted leader in the region’s B2B exhibition landscape, delivering impactful trade shows that shape industries and accelerate business growth. Based in Dubai, we are the regional arm of Messe Frankfurt GmbH, one of the world’s largest and most respected exhibition organisers, with a legacy of excellence spanning over 800 years. Our global network, industry expertise, and commitment to innovation enable us to create powerful business platforms that connect suppliers, buyers, and industry leaders worldwide.
 



  





 Our diverse and growing portfolio includes some of the Middle East’s most recognised trade fairs such as Intersec, Beautyworld Middle East, Automechanika Dubai, and Light \+ Intelligent Building Middle East. These events not only reflect evolving industry trends but also drive collaboration, innovation, and long\-term business growth across multiple sectors.
 



  





 We are looking for a highly organised and commercially aware Project Manager, Operations to join our Operations team. Acting as a key support across exhibition planning and delivery, this role plays a critical part in ensuring the smooth execution of events across the UAE and KSA, delivering operational excellence and a high\-quality experience for exhibitors, visitors, and stakeholders.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing:** 




  





**Show Planning \& Operational Delivery** 



* Support the planning and delivery of exhibitions from pre\-show through to onsite and post\-show operations
* Coordinate with internal teams including Sales, Marketing, Creative, Finance, CRM, IT, and HR to ensure operational requirements are delivered effectively
* Manage operational timelines and workflows using project management tools such as Monday.com
* Support show budget tracking and maintain visibility of operational costs throughout the project lifecycle



**Venue \& Supplier Management** 



* Liaise closely with venues across the UAE and KSA including DWTC and other exhibition centres
* Coordinate venue services including security, housekeeping, catering, rigging, health \& safety, and logistics
* Manage communication with appointed contractors, suppliers, and service partners to ensure smooth event delivery
* Attend planning, kickoff, and final operational meetings with venue stakeholders and partners



**Exhibitor \& Technical Coordination** 



* Work alongside Technical teams to ensure floorplans, exhibitor portals, and operational requirements are delivered within agreed timelines
* Support exhibitors and third\-party suppliers with operational planning and onsite participation requirements
* Oversee show build\-up and breakdown, ensuring compliance with venue regulations and tenancy schedules



**Event Features, Branding \& Activations** 



* Coordinate exhibition signage, sponsorship branding, feature areas, VIP lounges, conferences, awards, and event activations
* Work closely with Marketing, Creative Studio, and external partners to ensure all deliverables are executed to a high standard and within deadlines



**Logistics, Registration \& General Operations** 



* Support shipping, customs clearance, onsite handling, registration requirements, staffing coordination, catering, internet, badges, and event materials
* Assist with post\-show reporting and continuous improvement initiatives across operational processes



**Accounting \& Budget Management** 



* Coordinate purchase orders, supplier quotations, and operational expenditure tracking in line with company procedures
* Monitor budgets and support cost control throughout the planning and delivery cycle



  





  





**What You’ll Bring:** 



* 5\+ years’ experience within exhibition or event operations, ideally in the UAE or KSA market
* Strong understanding of exhibition planning, venue operations, and supplier coordination
* Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and tight deadlines simultaneously
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive, solutions\-focused mindset
* Experience using Microsoft Office and project management tools such as Monday.com
* Ability to work effectively under pressure within a fast\-paced, international environment
* Strong attention to detail with a hands\-on and collaborative approach



  





  





**Why Join Us?** 




 At Messe Frankfurt Middle East, you’ll be part of a collaborative and high\-performing team delivering some of the region’s leading exhibitions and events. This role offers the opportunity to work across exciting international projects, build strong industry relationships, and play a key role in the successful delivery of large\-scale events across the Middle East.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Department \| Psychology**
**American University of Sharjah**
 The Department of Psychology in the College of Arts and Sciences at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applications for the position of Head of Department. The department seeks a collaborative and visionary leader with a record of excellence in teaching, research and service, and a strong commitment to student success and faculty development.
   

  

**About The Department**
 The department offers a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and contributes significantly to the university’s general education curriculum. Faculty members are engaged in diverse areas of research, including mental health and well\-being; cognitive psychology and psycholinguistics; organizational psychology; and social, cultural and personality psychology. The department values multidisciplinary collaboration and emphasizes both scientific rigor and applied engagement with the community.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Applicants must meet the following minimum qualifications:
   

  

* PhD in Psychology or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum rank of Associate Professor (Professor preferred).
* A record of effective and inclusive academic leadership, including experience in personnel management and decision\-making.
* Evidence of excellence in teaching, research and service.
* Experience with program accreditation, curriculum development and faculty evaluation.
* Familiarity with North American models of higher education.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 In addition to the above, the college will give preference to candidates who demonstrate:
   

  

* Experience as a department chair, program director or equivalent academic leadership role.
* Success in developing and supporting undergraduate and/or graduate programs.
* Commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration within the college and across the university.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor faculty, support student engagement and foster research productivity.
* A clear vision for the future development of the department, consistent with the strategic goals of the college and university.


**Responsibilities**
 The Head of Department will:
   

  

* Provide strategic leadership and foster a collegial and inclusive departmental culture.
* Foster and promote the professional growth of faculty in teaching and research.
* Oversee curriculum planning, program assessment and accreditation.
* Represent and advocate for the department within the college and university.
* Recruit and retain high\-quality faculty and students.
* Engage in teaching and scholarship at the undergraduate and/or graduate level.
* Participate in university service and governance.


**Date of Commencement**
 The position begins mid\-August 2026\.
   

  

**Application Procedure**
 Applicants should apply online at \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01");" rel\="nofollow"\>https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01\.
   

  

**Applicants Should Submit**
* A cover letter describing their research, teaching and administrative experience, and articulating their vision for how they can contribute to the department’s development and success.
* A current curriculum vitae.
* Names and contact information for three referees (references will be contacted only for shortlisted candidates).


*Additional materials may be requested from candidates advancing to later stages of the search.*
 Applications received by December 15, 2025, will receive full consideration; review will continue until the position is filled.
   

  

**About American University Of Sharjah**
 American University of Sharjah (AUS) is a comprehensive, independent, non\-profit, coeducational institution of higher education that promotes excellence in teaching, learning, research and creative work. AUS fosters a community that celebrates diversity and whose members are committed to the ideals of open intellectual inquiry, ethical behavior and civic responsibility.
   

  

 AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to approximately 6,000 students from over 100 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. Among the top 18 percent of ranked universities in the world (QS World University Rankings, 2026\), AUS is consistently among the top ten universities in the Arab region (QS Arab Region University Rankings, 2026\).
   

  

 AUS is located in the heart of Sharjah’s University City, adjacent to the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park and just minutes from Sharjah International Airport and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The campus is situated in a vibrant and cosmopolitan area offering abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.aus.edu.

data.jd_text:
Ever since it was founded in 1931 in Montreux, Switzerland, Clinique La Prairie has built an international reputation as an award\-winning destination, renowned for delivering the most progressive health and wellbeing programs in an ambience of unparalleled luxury Swiss hospitality.
 



  





 The Longevity Hub by Clinique La Prairie offers a first access to the Clinique La Prairie method in selected urban locations, combining pioneering longevity, wellbeing and aesthetic technologies in an exclusive environment. Here, beauty is understood not as a surface correction but as the visible expression of a healthier biology, the most immediate manifestation of CLP’s commitment to extending the quality, resilience and vitality of human life. Our guests engage regularly with experts to build hyper\-personalized routines that unlock longevity and lasting wellbeing.
 



  





  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 As Medical Director, you are a key ambassador of the Longevity Hub by Clinique La Prairie, delivering the most advanced longevity solutions within a luxury environment. This is a dual role: you lead the Hub’s medical operations and you practise medicine every day, seeing guests in consultation as a physician. Our commitment is to help and inspire our guests to live a healthier, longer and fuller life — guided by the principle that the earlier the intervention, the more elegant the outcome, and that preservation is always more powerful than rescue. (Note: Maintain relationships with local medical authorities and serve as the designated medical authority within the Hub, in accordance with the responsibilities and duties of a Medical Director as defined by local regulatory requirements.)
 



  





 You create and maintain a culture of care and service excellence, lead the efficient and effective delivery of all medical operations, including short and long\-term strategic planning — and embody the CLP philosophy of biological authenticity: interventions that work with the guest’s biology, never against it, so that results look natural, durable and entirely faithful to the person.
 



 The position calls for a rare balance of six profiles:
 


* **Practising Physician**
* **Scientist**
* **Operator**
* **Team Leader**
* **Brand Ambassador**
* **Guest Experience Leader**



  





**KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Medical practice** 



* Practise medicine daily — consult with guests, understand their concerns and goals, diagnose, analyze check\-up results and ensure a global, longitudinal management of their health all across the 4 pillars of the CLP Longevity Method (Medical, Nutrition, Wellbeing and Movement)
* Establish and maintain medical protocols, and fully understand the internal processes of all departments.
* Deliver care across the three dimensions of the CLP method — prevention, which protects biological function before visible decline; maintenance, which sustains results through longitudinal follow\-up; and amplification, which actively improves quality through targeted intervention.
* Prescribe or administer medication, therapy and other specialized medical care, selecting interventions that work with the guest’s anatomy and biology
* Supervise the execution of the consultations, tests and treatments included in the membership; explain procedures and discuss results and prescribed treatments with guests.
* Provide health and wellness advice — diet, physical activity, hygiene and disease prevention and support guests on long\-term, regenerative and preventive treatment plans.
* Master the key applications of new anti\-aging and regenerative technologies — ozone therapy, IV drips, toxicity evaluation testing and detoxification plans.
* Maintain detailed, up\-to\-date medical records and prepare official health documents when required.
* Participate in the recruitment of new physicians and medical team members.
* Organize weekly meetings with the medical team and report monthly to the Global Medical Director.



  





**Operational practice** 



* Manage the establishment and continuous monitoring of the medical licence, maintaining the relationship with local medical authority, monitoring the regulatory landscape.
* Implement the compliance procedures requested by corporate.
* Establish Local Operating Procedures (LOP) and keep the KMS updated for all local procedures and compliance documents.
* Monitor procedure execution against corporate quality standards, gather improvement points and address the learning curve with the Hub pillar teams.
* Secure the application of infection control and medical\-waste management while monitoring nursing activity, and oversee the stock of medical consumables and the procurement process.
* Ensure the continuous update of the Client Health Record and related incident reporting, liaising with local authorities where needed, and manage record exchange with the Montreux Health Resort under the Data Transfer Agreement.
* Oversee the guest journey — from appointments through to the follow\-up plan foreseen by the membership program.
* Implement and monitor external providers that enhance Hub treatments (laboratory tests, cognitive exercises and others).
* Oversee the maintenance plans of longevity equipment and coordinate support interventions as defined by supplier contracts.
* Report daily to the Hub General Manager, and monthly to the Corporate Medical Director and the Corporate Medical \& Longevity Operational Excellence Director.



  





**SKILLS, EXPERIENCE \& REQUIREMENTS** 



* Doctor of Medicine (MD), licence eligible to practise in the UAE (DHA / DoH). A specialty in Internal Medicine, Functional Medicine or Aesthetic Surgery is a plus.
* Internal Medicine Certification or recognition from a leading university (QS World University medicine rankings), ideally complemented by certification in anti\-aging and regenerative medicine.
* At least 5 years of clinical experience in the chosen specialty, with a genuine passion for both people and science and a real interest in longevity and preventive medicine.
* A practising clinician, comfortable seeing guests every day and combining hands\-on medical practice with the leadership of a medical team; able to prescribe and administer medications and other non\-surgical treatments.
* Knowledge of skin and facial aging as a multi\-tissue, multi\-level process, and of regenerative, aesthetic and lifestyle interventions that amplify healthspan rather than merely correcting appearance.
* Wide knowledge of aging research — biomarkers of aging, biological\-age testing, and longevity therapies addressing senescence\-driven decline; scientific publications and society memberships are an advantage.
* Strong ability to lead a multicultural team, with a confident presence, a self\-driven attitude and a positive mindset.
* Able to travel to Switzerland and other CLP locations for training, and to complete CLP’s onboarding and refresher programs.



  





**THE IDEAL PROFILE** 




  





 The ideal Medical Director combines strong clinical credentials in their specialty — Internal Medicine, General Practice, Aesthetic Medicine or Aesthetic Surgery — with deep longevity expertise, operational leadership and a luxury hospitality mindset.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove** 




 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
 



 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
 



  





**What You’ll be Doing** 




 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
 



 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
 



  





 Core Responsibilities
 


* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.
* Ensure compliance with transportation, safety, and operational standards.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, operational updates, and board presentations.
* Build scalable operational processes and frameworks to enable faster and more repeatable expansion.
* Perform operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and data tracking using advanced Excel and BI tools.



  





**What You will need for this position** 



* Experience: 5–7 years in project or program management within mobility, transportation, fleet operations, logistics, or technology; proven track record of delivering cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education / Skills: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Business, Transportation, or Technology; PMP or equivalent preferred; advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency required.
* Traits: Exceptional stakeholder management, highly analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, GCC market\-savvy, strong communicator, and able to lead without authority across complex cross\-functional teams.



  





**Key Metrics** 



* On\-time, on\-budget delivery of mobility projects across UAE.
* Quality and accuracy of executive dashboards, project reporting, and operational updates.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across internal functions and external OEM and technology partners.
* Speed and repeatability of new market launches enabled by scalable operational frameworks.
* Compliance and risk management across all active projects and UAE market operations.

 Directly reporting to our Managing Director, and closely working with our UAE Operations Team.

 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
 



 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.

Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third\-party integration boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross\-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
* Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third\-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
* Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade\-offs, and cross\-team dependencies
* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
* Lead incident coordination, post\-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
* Own go\-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross\-functional readiness sign\-offs
* Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
* Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
* Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
* Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
* Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high\-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the team's capability to do the same


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager in a fast\-paced engineering organisation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and architectural trade\-offs
* Background in fundamental engineering concepts including SSDLC, testing methodologies, API monitoring metrics, and SLAs
* Proficiency with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent)
* Experience managing programmes with significant third\-party integration dependencies
* Familiarity with programme management and analytics tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence, dashboarding tools)
* Operationally fluent with AI tools: for programme synthesis, risk stress\-testing, and communication
* Deep familiarity with the delivery complexity of programmes with significant external API and third\-party integration dependencies — including SLA implications, incident ownership boundaries, and rollback constraints across organisational lines
* Strong communication skills — able to distil complex information clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple teams and manage cross\-organisational stakeholders
* Proven ability to operate with confidence in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with frequent priority shifts
* Passionate problem solver who adapts their approach to evolving requirements and organisational contexts


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

**Eaton's Global Data Center Segment** 
 is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Quality Manager – Global Data Center Segment** 
 . This position is a senior, globally accountable leader that is leader responsible for defining, governing, and continuously improving the end‑to‑end quality framework for post‑order execution across
 **Eaton’s Global Data Center Segmen** 
 t.
   

  

 Operating within the
 **Post Order Center of Excellence (CoE)** 
 , this role ensures that quality is designed into execution—not inspected in after the fact—by establishing global standards, assurance mechanisms, testing rigor, and process discipline that scale across regions, customers, and service offers. * Your growth matters – We invest in long‑term development through continuous learning, upskilling, and global programs via Eaton University.
* Your contributions matter – Reliability, safety, efficiency, and sustainability are at the heart of what we do, driving meaningful impact on people’s lives and the environment.
* Your wellbeing matters – Health, safety, and wellness are a priority. At Eaton, wellbeing goes beyond programs, empowering employees with the tools and environment to thrive.

Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.

**Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**Quality, Safety \& Risk**
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Mentor and develop engineers and discipline leads across the Middle East rail team.
* Collaborate effectively with global rail colleagues and contribute to cross\-region technical excellence.
* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned and regional best practice across the business.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working across both regional and international rail programmes, including high\-speed rail, metro and light rail.
* Established relationships with key regional rail clients, authorities or delivery partners would be advantageous.

data.jd_text:
**Account Director – Social, Content, Influencer \& Performance** 




**Company:** 
 Techne Agency
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai (Managing a UK team) / Hybrid or Remote (with travel when required)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Start Date:** 
 Q3 2026
 



  





**About Techne Agency** 





 Techne is a boutique marketing agency operating at the intersection of brand, content and performance. We specialise in social media, content production, influencer marketing, paid media and website content, delivering integrated strategies across the full customer journey.
 





 We work with premium and luxury brands across hospitality, fashion, beauty and technology, supporting both brand\-building and performance\-driven marketing with a strong track record of results across the UK, UAE and Europe.
 





 Our teams are based across London and Dubai, working with clients on both sides — European and UAE markets. This international footprint allows us to combine cultural relevance, creative execution and performance expertise across multiple markets.
 





 As the agency continues to grow, we are building a senior leadership layer to support this expansion. We are looking for someone who can help shape the future of the business, elevate our standards and play a key role in delivering exceptional work across all clients.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We're looking for a senior operator to lead client delivery across the agency and act as the right hand to the Founder \& CEO.
 





 This is a pivotal role within Techne, offering the opportunity to take ownership of high\-profile client relationships, shape the quality and direction of our work, and build a delivery function designed to scale.
 





 This is not a traditional account management role. You will operate across multiple disciplines — combining strategic oversight, team leadership and hands\-on execution to ensure consistently exceptional output. You'll manage the team, own the day\-to\-day, and be the person who keeps everything moving to a high standard.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Leadership** 



* Own senior client relationships across our European and UAE portfolio, acting as the main point of contact for strategy, performance and escalation
* Lead communication and direction across retainers and projects, ensuring accounts are proactively managed
* Identify and drive growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new business where relevant
* Balance client ambition with operational feasibility — ensuring what gets sold can be delivered



**Delivery \& Standards** 



* Take full ownership of delivery across all accounts, including the transition from new business into execution
* Oversee social media, content production, influencer campaigns, paid performance, and website and editorial content
* Define clear processes and pipelines to deliver each scope item to a high standard
* Challenge output and hold a high bar for creative and strategic quality across all functions
* Understand team strengths and gaps, and step in where needed to support or unblock delivery
* Be comfortable getting hands\-on when required to demonstrate standards or solve execution challenges



**Team Leadership** 



* Manage and develop the social, content, influencer and performance team across London and Dubai
* Set clear expectations and hold the team accountable for performance and delivery
* Provide regular visibility to the Founder \& CEO on team performance, risks and priorities
* Build a culture of ownership, pace and accountability — shifting the team from reactive execution to structured, proactive delivery



**Operations \& Problem Solving** 



* Continuously review workflows, resourcing and delivery structures
* Identify inefficiencies and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Expand and improve the agency's network of vendors, tools and capabilities
* Move the team from ad\-hoc execution to structured, repeatable systems over time



**Growth \& New Business** 



* Support the CEO and the Client Growth Manager on new business pitches through strong strategic, creative and operational input
* Shape proposals, scopes and pricing aligned with both client ambition and delivery capability
* Contribute ideas to improve the agency's offering, positioning and commercial structure



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 7–10 years in a digital marketing agency environment, with at least 2–3 years at a senior account or director level
* Strong working knowledge across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid performance and website content — you don't need to execute everything, but you need to know what good looks like
* Proven experience owning client relationships and driving account growth, not just managing delivery
* Experience managing and developing junior and mid\-level team members
* Commercially aware — strong understanding of scope, resourcing and how to protect margin
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, lean agency — this is not a corporate role
* Experience working with premium or luxury brands — you understand the standard these clients expect
* Based in Dubai with UK market experience, or based in the UK with proven UAE market experience
* Highly solutions\-oriented, with a bias for action and ownership over process



  





**A Note from the Founder** 





 This role is central to the next stage of growth at Techne across London, Dubai and New York.
 





 I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of client delivery, elevate standards across the team and help build a more scalable and structured way of operating — without losing the pace and quality that defines how we work.
 





 This is not a hands\-off or purely strategic role. You'll be expected to lead from the front, bring solutions and step into execution when needed. If you're looking for a highly structured corporate environment, this likely isn't the right fit. If you're motivated by ownership, pace and building something, we should speak.

* Monitor customer feedback trends and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure accurate documentation, tracking, and resolution of customer feedback and service issues.

 8\. Strategic Planning \& Expansion

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Order accuracy and cancellation rates
* Refund and complaint reduction
* Cost control and operational efficiency
* Campaign performance and ROI

* Strong understanding of delivery aggregators, food delivery platforms, and logistics operations.
* Proven experience in KPI management, sales growth, and operational optimization.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in reporting tools, Microsoft Excel, and operational dashboards.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-market environment.
