**About IC Markets** 




 IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.
 



 IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.
 



 Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-impact programmes across multiple engineering teams. This senior role is the critical connective layer between engineering, product, architecture, and leadership. responsible for resolving cross\-team dependencies, driving delivery of intricate technical projects, and ensuring predictable, high\-quality outcomes at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency combined with exceptional programme management skills, and thrives in navigating ambiguity across distributed, multi\-disciplinary teams within a regulated fintech environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Cross\-Team Dependency \& Complex Delivery Management** 



* Own and drive resolution of cross\-team technical dependencies across 8–12\+ engineering squads
* Establish and maintain programme\-level dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths
* Lead planning and execution of complex, multi\-team deliveries spanning months or multiple quarters
* Identify inter\-team blockers early and orchestrate timely resolution with engineering leads and architects
* Coordinate integration milestones, shared API contracts, and platform\-level dependencies across squads



  





**Delivery \& Release Governance** 



* Define and enforce delivery governance frameworks for large\-scale technical programmes
* Ensure production readiness through structured release checkpoints, go/no\-go criteria, and sign\-off processes
* Oversee end\-to\-end release management across parallel workstreams, coordinating across QA, DevOps, and Platform teams
* Monitor programme health, critical path, and execution risks; escalate proactively to leadership
* Drive standardization of release and deployment governance across the engineering organization



  





**Technical Programme Leadership** 



* Partner with Engineering Leads, Principal Engineers, and Architects to translate technical strategy into actionable delivery plans
* Lead structured programme ceremonies: dependency syncs, architecture reviews, cross\-team planning, and programme\-level retrospectives
* Maintain and evolve Agile and hybrid delivery frameworks tailored to programme complexity and team maturity
* Drive PI Planning and large\-scale increment coordination across product and platform squads



  





**Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement** 



* Serve as the primary delivery interface for senior stakeholders, CTO, and executive leadership on complex programmes
* Produce clear, data\-driven programme status reports, risk dashboards, and delivery forecasts for leadership review
* Translate complex technical interdependencies into business\-level impact narratives for non\-technical audiences
* Proactively manage expectations, surface trade\-offs, and recommend delivery options under constraint.



  





**Tooling \& Delivery Intelligence** 



* Own and evolve programme\-level Jira structures including epics hierarchies, dependency links, cross\-project boards, and automation
* Drive delivery intelligence through advanced metrics: cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, dependency resolution SLAs.
* Build and maintain executive\-level dashboards that surface programme health, risk, and delivery confidence
* Ensure tooling practices support audit readiness and compliance requirements in a regulated financial services environment



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* 10\+ years in Technical Delivery Management, Programme Management, or Engineering Leadership roles
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi\-team technical programmes in a regulated or high\-stakes environment
* Deep expertise in cross\-team dependency management across large engineering organizations (8\+ teams)
* Strong technical fluency; ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects, and platform teams on technical trade\-offs
* Extensive experience with Agile at scale frameworks and hybrid delivery models
* Advanced Jira administration, programme\-level workflow design, and delivery metrics expertise
* Proven experience driving complex release governance across distributed, parallel workstreams
* Experience working in fintech, trading platforms, or high\-frequency, regulated product environments strongly preferred
* Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in a fast\-paced, high\-complexity environment

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction
   

  

* Work closely with Engg, Manufacturing systems manager, supply chain and purchasing on new product industrialisation in a timely manner


 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness


**Role Context**
 The Plant Director operates within a manufacturing environment serving utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across the Middle East and export markets. The role leads a multi disciplinary operations organisation, overseeing manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and HSE, within a competitive, cost sensitive, and delivery driven market.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manufacturing Operations Director, the role works in close collaboration with regional Sales, Projects, Engineering, Procurement, and corporate functions to align plant capability with customer demand, strategic growth plans, and localisation requirements. The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in management, electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or related fields.
* Understand manufacturing business, people management, supply chain management, financial management, quality management, and innovation.
* Possess experience in middle or senior management minimum of 10\-15 years.


**Job\-Specific Skills**
* Communication
* Values and respects others, Building relationships, Teamwork
* Process Loss Elimination Techniques
* Continuous improvement
* Project Management
* Creative Thinking
* Change Innovation
* Develops others
* Builds successful teams, Supports \& coaches the team
* Consulting skills
* Visionary leadership
* Achieving results, Customer driven
* Critical decision making
* Develops organisation budgets
* Organizational safety
* Financial astuteness
* Broad experience of developing and implementing short to long\-range objectives and strategies to achieve business goals.
* Proven capability of operating successfully at a senior management level.
* Understanding of electrical mechanical design engineering, competence in electrical power engineering.
* Demonstrate financial acumen including planning and cost control capabilities and proven experience of managing projects to budget.
* Proven track record in delivering manufacturing and supply chain best practice
* Strong working ethic in the delivery of satisfying the profitable requirements and expectations of internal and external customers.
* Effectively recognise and manage conflict
* Broad experience of working in a multi\-national, matrix organisation.
* Strong communications and presentation skills.
* Strong English written and verbal communication skills.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Creates strong team \& guiding partner
* Promotes team accountability \& strong sense of understanding

**Project Manager: Ecommerce Operations** 




 This is an on\-site role in Dubai

 As the company scales across existing and new countries, Ecommerce Operations is evolving to support increasingly complex logistics, fulfillment, payments, marketplaces and operational launches.
 



  





 As Project Manager: Ecommerce Operations, this role will own the management and execution of critical ecommerce operational projects across logistics, marketplaces, payments, country launches and operational scalability initiatives.
 



  





 The expectation is high ownership, urgency, follow\-through and strong execution. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and collaborator who proactively drives projects forward, removes blockers quickly, escalates risks early and ensures launches happen successfully and scale operationally.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities \& Weightages** 




**1\. Ecommerce Operations Project Management — 30%** 




 Own end\-to\-end management and execution of critical Ecommerce Operations projects.
 



  





 Responsibilities include:
 


* Managing multiple ecommerce operational projects simultaneously
* Creating clear timelines, owners, milestones and execution plans
* Coordinating cross\-functional stakeholders across Ecommerce, Product, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Customer Support and external partners
* Following up consistently to maintain execution momentum
* Identifying blockers, risks and dependencies early
* Escalating issues clearly and constructively
* Ensuring projects launch operationally stable and scalable
* Driving post\-launch stabilization, reporting and optimization
* Using project management tools effectively; prior Basecamp experience is a definite plus



  





 The expectation is excellent ownership, communication, urgency and execution discipline.
 



  





**2\. Logistics, Fulfillment \& Delivery Operations — 25%** 




 Support logistics and fulfillment transformation initiatives across existing and new markets.
 



  





 Responsibilities include:
 


* Managing logistics partner evaluation, onboarding and transition projects
* Supporting forward fulfillment, reverse fulfillment and COD operational readiness
* Coordinating delivery capability improvements, including faster delivery propositions where relevant
* Working with logistics technology platforms and delivery partners on implementation
* Monitoring delivery SLAs, fulfillment performance and operational stability
* Coordinating issue resolution across logistics, warehouse and customer support teams
* Driving continuous improvements in delivery experience, cost and reliability



  





 The expectation is scalable, reliable and commercially sensible ecommerce logistics execution.
 



  





**3\. Marketplace \& New Channel Operations — 15%** 




 Own operational execution for marketplace, partner channel and new market launch initiatives.
 



  





 Responsibilities include:
 


* Managing operational readiness for new ecommerce channels and partner integrations
* Coordinating catalog, pricing, inventory, fulfillment and customer experience workflows
* Aligning internal stakeholders and external partners ahead of launch
* Supporting launch governance, testing, issue resolution and operational stabilization
* Monitoring operational performance post\-launch and driving improvements
* Ensuring new channels are operationally scalable and commercially viable



  





 The expectation is smooth launches, strong partner coordination and disciplined post\-launch execution.
 



  





**4\. Commercial Operations \& Catalog Expansion Support — 15%** 




 Support operational execution for strategic commercial initiatives and catalog growth programs.
 



  





 Responsibilities include:
 


* Coordinating operational readiness for large\-scale catalog expansion initiatives
* Working with Brand Portfolio Managers, Supply Chain, Warehouse and Ecommerce teams
* Supporting stock readiness, pricing, promotions and operational workflows

* Ensuring catalog growth initiatives are operationally scalable
* Identifying process improvements and automation opportunities



  





 The expectation is strong operational support for growth initiatives without creating unnecessary manual complexity.

 Own payment partner evaluation, implementation coordination and operational management.
 



  





 Responsibilities include:
 


* Researching and evaluating leading payment service providers
* Managing proposal collection, commercial comparisons and recommendation documents
* Coordinating approvals, implementation planning and launch readiness
* Working closely with Finance, Product, Engineering and external PSP partners
* Monitoring payment performance, cost, reliability and operational issues post\-launch
* Managing ongoing PSP relationships and optimization opportunities



  





 The expectation is commercially sharp and operationally reliable payment execution.
 



  





**6\. Reporting, Visibility \& Process Improvement — 5%** 




 Drive operational visibility, reporting and continuous improvement.
 



  





 Responsibilities include:
 


* Maintaining clear project trackers, dashboards and status updates
* Providing concise stakeholder visibility on progress, blockers and risks
* Identifying recurring operational inefficiencies proactively
* Supporting SOP creation, process improvement and automation initiatives
* Reducing manual dependency and improving operational scalability



  





 The expectation is operational clarity, transparency and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Success Profile**

* Communicates clearly and collaborates well across teams

data.jd_text:
**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As project manager he/she is the primary point for all project\-related activities, holding the overall responsibility for the successful execution of the project. He/she represents the Company towards the Client and resolve issues related to project implementation, ensuring full alignment with contractual, technical, and procedural requirements.
   

  

 This role is specifically focused on supporting clients in the Middle East region.
   

  

 The following are the key responsibilities and requirements associated with this position.
   

  

**Project Planning and Documentation**
* Prepare comprehensive project plans and schedules.
* Develop and update project documentation, including Risk Assessment and Method Statement (RAMS), Installation and Test Plan (ITP), intervention preparation report, Factory Acceptance test (FAT) procedure, Site Acceptance Test (SAT) procedure, project close\-out report.
* Ensure documentation complies with company standards, contractual obligations, and customer\-specific requirements.


**Project Execution and Monitoring**
* Manage end\-to\-end project execution, ensuring deliverables meet or exceed expectations in terms of quality, timelines, and budget.
* Oversee engineering design, procurement, manufacturing and field activities to ensure compliance with specifications.
* Coordinate with sales back\-office for order processing, confirmations and invoicing.
* Monitor project performance (time, cost, scope), proactively address risks and changes, and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Ensure that the level of performance is in accordance with the Contract specifications, that the costs fall within the estimate limits, and that the execution time of the project phases progress as set down in the contract.
* Maintain strong client communication to ensure satisfaction and alignment
* Support resolution of payment issues, managing sensitive discussions with professionalism and cultural awareness.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the primary interface for the customer, managing communications, project reviews, audits, and system validation activities.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams: Manufacturing, Logistics, Backoffice, IT, Installation, Commissioning, and Services.
* Coordinate with partners, suppliers, and subcontractors familiar with or operating in the Middle East.
* Assist the sales team with negotiations for variation orders and scope changes.
* Build and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with clients and key stakeholders.


**After sales support**
* Support the After\-Sales team in coordinating local field rework or replacement activities.


**Reporting and Compliance**
* Provide regular reporting on project status, including financial forecast.
* Maintain accurate project records and complete close\-out documentation.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, technical specifications, and company policies and procedures.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or similar.
* Proven experience in project management, preferably in industrial environments.
* Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Arabic is highly advantageous; knowledge of French and/or Italian is an asset.
* Strong client\-facing and communication skills, with critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Senior professional willing to take responsibilities and Good knowledge of the project management tools and techniques
* Experience in negotiating with external service providers and contractors.
* Background in managing field teams within technical engineering contexts.
* Understanding of High Voltage and Power Distribution markets is a plus, including asset integrity and monitoring, sensing technologies, commissioning, testing and diagnostics.
* Good knowledge of communication, electrical, electronic and network instruments.
* Open to frequent travel on short notice in Middle East, and at EOSS facilities in Switzerland and Italy.
* PMP certification or similar is a plus.


**Key Skills For The Middle East Region**
* Cultural Sensitivity and Adaptability: Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment with respect for local customs, values, and communication styles.
* Strong Relationship Management: Ability to build trust and long\-term relationships with Middle Eastern clients, where personal rapport and reliability are highly valued.
* Resilience and Patience: Comfortable working in fast\-paced environments with possible changes in timelines or requirements; flexibility in adjusting to evolving client needs.
* Negotiation and Diplomacy: Skilled in managing complex discussions with professionalism and tact, balancing contractual obligations with client satisfaction.
* Understanding of Regional Logistics and Regulations: Familiarity with shipping, customs, and legal constraints within the GCC and broader Middle East.

Strong experience in luxury fit\-out and high\-end finishes, ideally within hotel environments. Experience working in a PMC/consultancy environment on complex developments. data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**




 To manage the facilities and operations within the assigned portfolio of assets/ buildings while implementing best supplier and customer relationship management, facilities management, building energy services management, maintenance, and contract management practices that improve the overall operational efficiency of managed assets, maintain high customer satisfaction,
 



 and help achieve Enova’s business objectives.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities**



* Provide inputs to the development of the overall division strategy and participate in developing the business unit strategy in line with the vision, mission, and business objectives of the company.
* Deliver the Facilities Management strategy while ensuring contractual commitments are successfully met.
* Manage the effective achievement of the business unit’s objectives through leading the Facilities and Operations team in the assigned project, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance.
* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Possesses extensive experience in key utilities, including but not limited to District cooling plants, Domestic water plant and network, Power distribution network, HV/LV substations and good knowledge in SCADA and BMS systems.
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations as well as minor projects, mechanical \& HVAC works, electrical works, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to equipment, Turbines, Generators, Chillers, HVAC, pumps, sewage lifting stations, substations, infrastructure networks, etc.).
* Attend all coordination meetings with the client.
* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power interruptions, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems)
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services Enova provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented
* Ensure availability of MS and RA for outsourced works
* Ensure relevant emergency tests are conducted
* Ensure that all departmental reports are prepared timely and accurately and meet requirements, policies, and standards.
* Perform other related duties or assignments as directed



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, \& Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management especially in Malls /Hospitality projects

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




  





 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the wise vision of Dubai’s leadership to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, while positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many futureproofing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, Area 2071, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, and Sandbox Dubai. DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of unlimited imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



  





 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




  





 Dubai Future Foundation recently launched Sandbox Dubai, a Regulatory Sandbox that centers around four key themes: Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Green technology, and Real Estate technology. We would like to invite talented and experienced individuals to join our dynamic team as we embark on this journey.
 



  





 As we embrace the challenges and opportunities of the modern regulatory landscape, we are seeking talented individuals who are eager to contribute their expertise and creativity to the Sandbox Dubai initiatives. We aim to explore novel solutions, foster collaboration across sectors, and pave the way for transformative changes that benefit both consumers and industries of Dubai.
 



  





 In the broader context of Sandbox Dubai, the Project Manager reports to the Head of Operations of Sandbox Dubai and will collaborate closely with the Sandbox team leads in Strategy, Policy, and Partnerships.
 



  





**Project Manager** 




  





 As a Project Manager within Sandbox Dubai, you will lead and manage sandbox programs and projects, including regulatory experiments, industry pilots, and innovation frameworks from concept to delivery or handover. You will manage multiple sandbox projects, deploy and enhance processes, coordinate cross\-functional teams, drive project timelines, engage diverse Future Foundation’s strategic goals.
 



  





**Project Management** 




  




* Full Project Lifecycle: Manage the full project cycle including managing projects timelines, budgets, milestones, setting objectives, monitoring and tracking progress, post project analysis and reporting.
* Project Development: Pitch sandbox projects with business cases, feasibility reports, and risk assessments tailored to sandbox\-specific initiatives.
* Sandbox Design \& Execution: Develop sandbox programs focused on regulatory experiments, technology validation, and proof\-of\-concept pilots across Sandbox priority areas (Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Green technology, and Real Estate technology).
* Global Tech Monitoring: Track international regulatory and innovation trends in key priority sectors to enhance the design of future sandbox initiatives and connect global themes/trends with opportunities for Dubai.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with legal, policy, strategy, and partnership teams to ensure project compliance and cross\-sector success.
* Documentation: Create and maintain project records, perform lessons\-learned assessments, and present reports to senior management.
* Team Collaboration: Communicate regularly with Sandbox team members and stakeholders to ensure projects run smoothly, providing updates to the Head of Operations and Director of Sandbox Dubai.
* Stakeholder Engagement and Third\-Party Relationships.
* Partner and collaborate with industry leaders, government agencies, startups, and regulatory bodies to align project goals. Ensure regular communication, and logistics are in place.
* Lead workshops, roundtables, and innovation sessions with relevant stakeholders to drive regulatory alignment and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with the Legal, Strategy, and Policy Teams to define regulatory exemptions, licensing terms, and compliance protocols.
* Work closely with finance, procurement and other internal teams to oversee procurement, invoices, and contracts ensuring legal compliance in all transactions.
* Support the development of policy proposals, regulatory models, and whitepapers in collaboration with Policy and Legal Teams.
* Ensure all projects comply with Sandbox governance frameworks, legal protocols, and international regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with the Marketing \& Communications Teams to enhance project visibility through media outreach and branding campaigns.



  





**Why this role is important?** 




  





 This role is central to translating Sandbox Dubai’s regulatory innovation goals into actionable Sandbox projects that drive policy reform, technology adoption and economic competitiveness. Moreover, this role is critical for providing operational management for core Sandbox projects throughout their lifecycle, fostering cross\-sector collaboration, and thus accelerating Dubai’s transformation into a global innovation hub.
 



  





**What Dubai Future Foundation offers?** 




  





 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with passionate people, support shapers of the future as well as work that has an impact, not only on the organization or the UAE but all of humankind.
 



  





 You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas and innovation.
 



  





**Skills** 




  




* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Public Policy, Law, Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Artificial Intelligence, or Technology Management. A Master’s degree is preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 Minimum of 7 years’ experience in project management, regulatory frameworks, or innovation\-driven programs with a proven track record of multi\-project management.
* **Specialization:** 
 Demonstrated experience in regulatory frameworks related projects, innovation ecosystems, and emerging tech pilots.
* **Industry Expertise:** 
 Experience working with government agencies, private sector entities, international organizations and technology hubs is required. Experience in one or more of the key priority thematic areas (AI/Technology, Healthcare, Infrastructure/Real Estate, or Sustainability) is strongly preferred.
* **Skills required:** 
 Excellent project management skills with high attention to detail and a strong dedication to completing projects within assigned deadlines, ability to multi\-task, coordinating multiple projects concurrently while partnering effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Demonstrable experience in regulatory modernization, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, project development, resource management, as well as using project planning and presentation tools (MS Project, PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI .. etc). Project management certifications (such as PMP/PMI\-Agile/SCRUM) preferred.
* **Communication and Stakeholder Engagement:** 
 Strong communication skills are required to effectively manage high\-level stakeholder relationships in public and private sectors and engage multidisciplinary teams. Ability to clearly articulate project updates to Sandbox and DFF leadership as well as external stakeholders, identify challenges, and mobilize cross\-team responses quickly.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluent in reading, writing \& presenting in both Arabic \& English.
* **Mindset:** 
 Agile, proactive, structured, self\-driven, and ready to work independently or as part of a collaborative team, and ability to drive cross\-functional collaboration, manage multiple projects, and meet tight deadlines.

 Years of Experience

data.jd_text:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.


**Disclaimer:** 
 Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

As Head of HR, you will work closely with leaders and their leadership teams across the Middle East with focus on UAE and Saudi\-Arabia to support the delivery of the people agenda.
   

  

 In this role, you will act as a trusted HR advisor on a broad range of people and organizational topics, helping leaders translate business priorities into effective people actions and play an important role in supporting leadership teams through change, organizational development, talent decisions, and workforce planning.
   

  

 This role combines senior HR partnering with hands\-on execution of (a.o.) HR cycle topics.

* Act as a strategic advisor to Executive Management on all HR and workforce\-related matters

* Manage employee relations and labor matters in line with UAE \& KSA labor laws

* Build trust with blue\-collar employees through visibility, accessibility, and consistent communication
* Support leaders in resolving employee issues, conflicts, and workplace challenges
* Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant HR practices
* Develop and implement HR policies and conduct audits to ensure governance and continuous improvement


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**
* Implement performance management practices aligned with business goals
* Support leaders in driving performance through effective people management
* Drive career development, succession planning, and talent initiatives
* Foster a high\-performance culture while ensuring employee engagement and sustainable workloads


**Compensation, Benefits \& Employee Value Proposition**
* Design and manage competitive compensation and benefits structures
* Lead salary benchmarking, job evaluations, and incentive programs
* Enhance benefits and offerings to meet both organizational and employee needs


**HR Operations, Systems \& Employee Experience**
* Oversee HR operations including HRIS, payroll coordination, and employee records
* Ensure smooth delivery of employee services (facilities, travel, housing, etc.)
* Manage HR systems, reporting, and workforce analytics
* Drive efficient processes while maintaining a positive employee experience


**HR Transformation, Projects \& Change Management**

* Manage HR projects end\-to\-end, ensuring delivery and impact
* Drive change management with strong focus on communication, adoption, and employee impact
* Ensure change initiatives are clearly communicated and understood by all workforce segments, including non\-office employees
* Define and track KPIs to measure both business and people outcomes


**What do I need to qualify for this role?**
* Strong experience in an HR Business Partner or HR leadership role, preferably in a global or matrixed organization
* Experience partnering with senior leaders on people, workforce, and organizational topics
* Experience managing large blue\-collar or operational workforce populations
* Proven experience in employee relations, labor law, and workforce management
* Experience supporting organizational change and leadership decision\-making
* A collaborative style and confidence working across all levels


**Qualifications \& Experience**

data.jd_text:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **VP – Infrastructure, Cloud and Operations** 
 , reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. The role will lead enterprise\-wide infrastructure strategy, cloud transformation, and technology operations, ensuring a secure, scalable, and high\-performance digital foundation across Dubai Holding’s diverse portfolio.
 



  





 This is a critical leadership role driving the evolution of infrastructure from traditional operations to AI\-enabled, autonomous platforms, while ensuring strong commercial discipline, resilience, and service excellence.
 



  





 If you are ready to operate at the intersection of technology, business, and transformation, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Infrastructure Strategy \& Transformation** 



* Define and execute Dubai Holding’s enterprise infrastructure and cloud strategy aligned to business growth and digital ambitions
* Lead large\-scale transformation of legacy environments into modern, cloud\-native and hybrid platforms
* Establish governance frameworks, standards, and policies ensuring security, scalability, and operational consistency
* Drive resilience strategies including disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure risk management



**Cloud \& Platform Leadership** 



* Lead multi\-cloud and hybrid cloud strategy across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments
* Oversee cloud migration, optimization, and cloud\-native adoption across business units
* Implement infrastructure\-as\-code and automation frameworks to accelerate deployment and scalability
* Build strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and leading infrastructure providers



**Operations \& Service Excellence** 



* Own end\-to\-end IT infrastructure operations and service delivery across all business units
* Implement ITIL\-aligned service management practices, including incident, change, and problem management
* Ensure 24/7 monitoring, performance optimization, and uptime across critical systems
* Establish SLAs, KPIs, and continuous improvement frameworks for operational excellence



**Commercial \& Financial Leadership** 



* Own infrastructure P\&L including total cost of ownership across on\-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments
* Develop business cases for infrastructure investments, clearly articulating ROI and value realization
* Drive FinOps maturity, including cost transparency, showback/chargeback models, and cloud optimization strategies
* Lead negotiations with hyperscalers, telecom providers, and strategic vendors to optimize commercial outcomes
* Establish infrastructure unit economics (e.g., cost per workload, user, or transaction) to enable data\-driven decisions
* Partner with Finance and Procurement to ensure governance, cost control, and scalable investment planning



**Network, Data Center \& Connectivity** 



* Oversee infrastructure lifecycle across compute, storage, and networking environments
* Lead network strategy including LAN, WAN, and connectivity across multiple assets and locations
* Drive virtualization, containerization, and platform optimization initiatives
* Ensure robust infrastructure security and performance across all environments



**Agentic AI\-Ready Infrastructure** 



* Architect AI\-native infrastructure platforms supporting large\-scale deployment of AI agents and advanced workloads
* Lead transition toward autonomous operations, including self\-healing infrastructure and predictive operations
* Enable intelligent orchestration of infrastructure resources based on real\-time demand and business context
* Define strategy for GPU and compute environments supporting AI, LLMs, and advanced analytics workloads
* Establish governance, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop frameworks for AI\-driven infrastructure operations
* Drive cultural transformation toward AI\-enabled operations and reduced manual intervention



**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management** 



* Partner with executive leadership to align infrastructure investments with strategic priorities
* Manage vendor ecosystem including cloud providers, MSPs, and telecom partners
* Oversee contract negotiations, performance management, and vendor governance frameworks
* Ensure alignment with security, architecture, and governance functions across the enterprise



**Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* Build and lead high\-performing infrastructure, cloud, and operations teams
* Define organization structure and capability roadmap across infrastructure and cloud functions
* Drive talent development, certifications, and future skills in cloud, automation, and AI\-enabled operations
* Foster collaboration across IT and business units to deliver integrated technology services



  





**Who we are looking for** 



* 18\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud, and operations, with significant leadership exposure in complex enterprise environments
* Proven track record in leading large\-scale infrastructure and cloud transformations
* Strong experience managing multi\-vendor ecosystems and enterprise\-scale infrastructure platforms
* Deep expertise across data centers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and network environments
* Demonstrated experience in financial management of infrastructure, including cost optimization and vendor commercial strategies
* Experience operating at executive level, influencing senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams



  





**Education / Professional Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field required
* Master’s degree preferred
* Certifications in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) highly valued
* ITIL, infrastructure, or project management certifications advantageous



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Enterprise infrastructure architecture (compute, storage, networking, virtualization)
* Cloud computing platforms and hybrid/multi\-cloud strategies
* Infrastructure automation, orchestration, and IaC frameworks

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****
* 15–18\+ years of relevant experience in Protection, Automation, Panel, or System Integration Engineering.
* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

* Engineering Tools
+ EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical
+ DIGSI, AcSELerator, EnerVista
+ ETAP / SKM

* Commercial Acumen
+ Strong understanding of technical specifications, BOM costing, value engineering, and project lifecycle

data.jd_text:
**Role Summary**
 The Customer Service Manager (CSM) is responsible for the day\-to\-day performance and stability of customer service operations in a fast\-paced fintech environment. This role requires a hands\-on, data\-driven leader with experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, capable of translating operational data into actionable insights. The CSM will drive service performance through queue management, capacity planning, root cause analysis (RCA), and Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, while working closely with internal teams and outsourced partners to deliver consistent, compliant, and high\-quality customer outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Insights (CSM Level)**
* Analyse customer service performance metrics including SLA, FCR, CSAT, NPS, AHT, backlog, abandonment, and repeat contacts
* Identify trends and drivers behind performance movements and translate them into clear operational actions
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for key issue types (e.g. remittance status checks, escalations, repeat contacts)
* Own and contribute to Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, highlighting recurring customer pain points and improvement opportunities
* Provide structured, insight\-led updates to the Head of Customer Service and senior stakeholders.


**Operational Service Delivery**
* Manage day\-to\-day customer service operations across voice, tickets, email, and in\-app support channels
* Oversee high\-volume call centre operations, ensuring queue health, responsiveness, and service stability
* Monitor ticket backlogs, ageing, and abandonment rates, taking corrective action where required
* Manage escalations, including coordination with internal teams and third\-party partners
* Lead and participate in daily stand\-ups to track performance, risks, and priorities


**Capacity Planning \& Workforce Management**
* Track service demand versus available capacity by channel and product
* Identify capacity gaps and support short\-term and medium\-term workforce planning
* Monitor agent productivity, utilisation, and adherence
* Support SLA and KPI discussions with outsourced partners using data\-backed insights


**CRM \& Process Discipline**
* Ensure consistent and accurate use of the CRM, including: a) Ticket logging and categorisation b) Status updates and escalation handling c) Routing and workflow adherence
* Maintain strong data hygiene to support reliable reporting and analysis
* Identify process inefficiencies or system gaps based on hands\-on operational experience


**People Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Provide hands\-on coaching and real\-time guidance to agents and team leads
* Reinforce service quality standards, communication best practices, and escalation protocols
* Act as a first point of support for complex or sensitive customer cases
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus


**Requirements**
* Proven experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, ideally within fintech, banking, or financial services
* Strong data and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance metrics and drive actions
* Hands\-on experience with CRM systems (ticketing, routing, reporting)
* Experience leading RCA and VoC analysis to drive service and process improvements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including collaboration with Product, Tech, Risk, and outsourced partners.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, regulated environment Desirable.
* Experience working with outsourced BPO partners.
* Exposure to fintech products such as payments, wallets, lending, or merchant services.
* Understanding of regulatory and compliance considerations in customer service operations. Success Measures
* Improved SLA, FCR, CSAT, and abandonment performance
* Reduced backlog and ageing tickets.
* Clear, actionable RCA and VoC insights influencing operational improvements.
* Stable and predictable day\-to\-day service delivery.
* Improved agent productivity and consistency

data.jd_text:
A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve issues and risks proactively.
   

  

**Digital \& AI Investment Management** 
 — Work with MEA business leaders to determine Enterprise AI and digital investment levels based on growth opportunity, organisational priorities, and budgetary considerations. Provide recommendations on technology investments, cost optimisation, and resource allocation to maximise commercial value and ROI.
   

  

**Business Relationship Management** 
 — Serve as the primary point of contact for MEA business and function leaders on Enterprise AI, data, and digital topics. Drive effective communication, manage expectations, and address systemic issues, escalations, and enhancement requests related to applications, infrastructure, and digital services.
   

  

**Service Delivery Assurance**

**Demand Intake \& Prioritisation**

**Governance, Security \& Architecture** 
 — Ensure 100% Security and Enterprise Architecture sign\-off on MEA projects. Drive adoption of standard, secure enterprise platforms that unlock data and AI opportunities at scale and protect the business.
   

  

**Talent \& Team Leadership** 
 — Lead, coach, and develop market\-aligned business process analysts and digital talent. Drive a strong Enterprise AI culture across the MEA team in line with the Ecolab leadership model, managing by influence across the broader Enterprise AI organisation.
   

  

**Position Details**
* Location: Middle East and Africa region (primary hub Dubai)
* Travel: Regional travel across Middle East and Africa; periodic international travel for Enterprise AI and Markets leadership engagements
* Reporting line: Solid\-line to the Global Markets Business Engagement Leader, with close alignment to the MEA Market Head as a member of the MEA market leadership team

* Master’s degree or equivalent (MBA, MSc) a plus


**Key Skills \& Leadership Behaviours**

* Growth mindset — relentless focus on unlocking new revenue, market share, and productivity through Enterprise AI and digital
* Ownership — drives delivery from idea to adoption to value capture, with no hand\-off gaps

 Enterprise AI is the technology and intelligence engine behind Ecolab’s global growth — delivering the AI, data, platforms, and digital solutions that help our customers and our 48,000 associates operate cleaner, safer, and more sustainably in more than 170 countries. We combine the agility of an AI\-first organisation with the scale and stability of a Fortune 500 enterprise, partnering closely with every Ecolab Division, Market, and Function to turn data and technology into measurable commercial growth.

**🚀 Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — Dubai HQ** 




 Trust Infrastructure for Device Financing in Emerging Markets
 



  





**Location:** 
 Dubai HQ (relocation) \+ regular business trips to operations countries
 



 (Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, and other emerging markets)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time · Senior Leadership
 



**Start:** 
 ASAP
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are building trust infrastructure for device financing in emerging markets — where millions of customers finance smartphones but do not trust banks, services, or promises.
 



 Care\+ is not a warranty department.
 



  





 It is an ecosystem of trust around the device: replacement, refurbishment, anti\-fraud, service operations, and lifecycle management.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — a founding\-level operational leader who will build and scale the entire after\-sales infrastructure across multiple countries.
 



  





 This role builds the department almost from zero — from 2 people to 8\+ senior team members during the first 18 months.
 



  





**What is Critically Important (must\-have experience)** 




 🔧
 **Device Certification** 




 — Practical experience in smartphone/consumer electronics certification in China
 



 — Real experience working with factories, certification labs, ODMs, and engineering teams
 



 — Understanding of factory documentation flow, typical bottlenecks, and “where things actually break.”
 



 — Experience with local device certification in Africa / SEA / LATAM countries
 



 — Understanding of local regulatory reality and launching devices in emerging markets
 



  





 📦
 **Spare Parts and Service Infrastructure** 




 — Deep understanding of spare parts movement and after\-sales logistics
 



 — Understanding of how spare parts actually move: factory → distributor → ASC → customer
 



 — Experience working with authorized service centers (ASC)
 



 — Understanding of SLA, replacement economics, refurbishment, and warranty operations
 



 — Understanding of local logistics reality in emerging markets, not only processes “on paper”
 



  





 🌍
 **Remote Management and Operational Audit** 




 — Proven experience in remote management of multi\-country service operations
 



 — Regular audits, inspections, and on\-site service center checks
 



 — Experience investigating:
 


* inventory leakage
* fake warranty claims
* fake parts
* grey market devices
* device swapping
* fake repairs



 — Ability to see the difference between reports and field reality
 



  





 👥
 **Hiring and Managing Local Managers** 




 — Experience hiring first\-level local Service / After\-Sales Managers
 



 — Ability to identify strong local operators “on the ground.”
 



 — Experience managing managers who work locally in\-country but functionally report to HQ
 



 — Experience building a controllable regional structure
 



 — Own network of service / after\-sales contacts in Africa or SEA is a major advantage
 



  





 📋
 **Standardization and Operational Discipline** 




 — Experience building standardized operational frameworks for multi\-country operations
 



 — Creation of SOPs, audit standards, escalation flows, and service protocols
 



 — Ability to establish consistent service quality across countries with different levels of market maturity
 



 — Ability to transform “manual management” into scalable operational infrastructure
 



 — Process discipline and reporting culture are non\-negotiable
 



  





**Strong Advantage** 




 — Experience working in the Dubai HQ of international companies
 



 — Experience working in: Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, Côte d’Ivoire, and other African countries
 



 — Experience in organizations such as Samsung, Transsion, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, realme, Huawei, HMD/Nokia
 



 — Understanding of how emerging markets operations really work outside corporate presentations
 



 — Experience in device financing / BNPL / smartphone financing ecosystems is a major advantage
 



  





**Basic Requirements** 




 — 8\+ years of experience in service / after\-sales / operations management
 



 — Multi\-country operations experience
 



 — Experience building and scaling teams
 



 — Strong analytical and operational mindset
 



 — English fluent (mandatory)
 



 — Willingness to travel: approximately 6–10 days/month during launch phase, with gradual reduction of travel load as operations scale
 



  





**Area of Responsibility** 




 — Building and managing the Care\+ ecosystem
 



 — Device certification in new markets
 



 — Development of service center network
 



 — Spare parts and refurbishment operations
 



 — Hiring, training, and functional management of local Service Managers
 



 — Anti\-fraud strategy and operational audit
 



 — Distributor and ASC relationship management
 



 — Building scalable operational infrastructure across multiple countries
 



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




 — Senior\-level compensation structure discussed individually based on interview results
 



 — Includes fixed base, transparent KPI bonus structure, and long\-term participation opportunity
 



 — Transparent KPI mechanism
 



 — Grace period during the first 2 months
 



 — Dubai HQ leadership role
 



 — International multi\-country scope
 



 — Long\-term leadership growth opportunity within the ecosystem
 



  





**Career Path** 




 Year 1–2: Head of Care\+ Ecosystem
 



 Year 2–3: VP Care\+ Operations
 



 Year 3\+: COO\-track / senior ecosystem leadership
 



  





**What is Important for This Role** 




 We are looking for someone who:
 



 — understands the difference between reports and reality
 



 — knows how to build controllable operations
 



 — is capable of building discipline and standards
 



 — can operate in the complex field reality of emerging markets
 



 — can simultaneously manage people, processes, and risks
 



  





 If you know how to build a controllable after\-sales infrastructure in environments where processes on paper and processes in reality are two different things, we would like to speak with you.

data.jd_text:
HKA is a leading global consultancy in risk mitigation, dispute resolution, expert witness and litigation support. We anticipate, investigate and resolve complex challenges by harnessing world\-leading multi\-disciplinary expertise and experience.
   

  

 As trusted independent consultants, experts and advisors, we deliver solutions amid uncertainty, dispute and overrun, and provide the insights that make the best possible outcomes a reality for public and private sector clients worldwide. Our experts have testified across the globe on many of the largest quantum, delay, engineering and commercial damages matters.
