data.jd_text:
The Clinical Informatics Specialist is responsible for supporting the development, implementation, adoption, optimization, training, and management of healthcare technology solutions. The role focuses on enhancing clinical practice through effective use of clinical systems and informatics tools that support patient care activities.
 



  





 The position works closely with Information Systems and clinical stakeholders to analyze workflows, improve operational efficiency, and ensure healthcare technology solutions align with professional standards, regulations, and organizational objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Clinical Informatics \& Workflow Optimization** 




  




* Evaluate informatics solutions to ensure quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.
* Apply comprehensive testing methodologies to all clinical informatics interventions.
* Analyze current clinical and business processes and recommend workflow improvements.
* Document current\-state and future\-state workflows impacted by clinical documentation systems.
* Assess implementation strategies and evaluate their impact on clinical workflows and operations.
* Understand how system content and functionality affect clinical practice and operational workflows.



  





**Systems Implementation \& Support** 




  




* Support the implementation, optimization, and adoption of clinical systems and applications.
* Act as a key contact for clinical informatics\-related questions, issues, and troubleshooting.
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to clinical users on system utilization and best practices.
* Coordinate with vendors and technical teams on system implementation and integration activities.



  





**Data Analysis \& Governance** 




  




* Identify data issues and risks related to clinical informatics activities.
* Conduct higher\-level analysis and provide recommendations to stakeholders and governance bodies.
* Interpret healthcare legislation, industry trends, and emerging standards to support organizational practices.
* Contribute to policy and procedure development related to clinical documentation and order management applications.



  





**Training \& Stakeholder Engagement** 




  




* Support and participate in training activities for healthcare providers and trainers.
* Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams and stakeholders to ensure successful system adoption.
* Communicate findings, recommendations, and project updates effectively to relevant stakeholders.



  





**Project Management \& Strategic Planning** 




  




* Lead and support large\-scale healthcare technology projects.
* Ensure project vision, direction, and deliverables align with organizational objectives.
* Utilize analytical models to evaluate solutions for business and information needs.
* Develop business plans including requirements analysis, solution alternatives, cost estimates, ROI analysis, implementation plans, and evaluation measures.
* Participate in strategic planning and priority\-setting activities considering budget and resource constraints.
* Prepare project status reports and related documentation.
* Perform other duties as assigned.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Clinical, Paramedical, Healthcare, or a related field.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in a supervisory or leadership capacity.
* Experience implementing and supporting clinical systems and applications, including Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), pharmacy systems, radiology systems, and other healthcare applications.
* Experience with health information exchange, electronic prescribing, pharmaceutical supply chain management, and disease condition management solutions.
* Experience conducting system assessments and audits to identify improvement opportunities.
* Experience supporting clinical users and providing system\-related guidance and training.
* Experience coordinating with vendors on implementation and integration activities.

**Demand and Delivery Management** 



* Direct and guide the comprehensive translation of business needs into IT projects and ensure timely, quality and efficient execution, in order to ensure effective IT support to other departments. Ensure adherence to time, cost and quality, in order to ensure efficient and effective delivery of services.

* Provide overall direction to the system development team to direct and lead the effective analysis of user requirements, development/enhancement of IT systems as per business priority in order to ensure effective IT services management in accordance to business requirements.

* Run structured discovery sessions with Finance, Treasury, FP\&A, Tax, and adjacent teams (Commercial, Operations) to map current processes against ERP capabilities.
* Identify and document: (a) capabilities we should be using but aren't, (b) features we use incorrectly, (c) manual workarounds that should live in the ERP, and (d) controls or audit requirements not yet enforced in the system.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of opportunities and issues, scored by impact, effort, risk, and dependencies.
* Own the ERP–Finance project portfolio end\-to\-end: intake, scoping, sprint planning, delivery, UAT, go\-live, and post\-launch measurement.
* Lead Sprint 0 artifacts for every initiative — Project Charter, Product Definition Document (PDD), Requirements \& Scope, Delivery \& Governance Plan — to the standard set by the team's SDLC framework.
* Coordinate with the Digital Solutions Lead and Engineers on technical delivery, integrations, customizations, and version upgrades.
* Govern ERP change requests: triage incoming asks, validate impact, ensure proper approvals, and manage release windows so finance close cycles are protected.
* Understand how ERP systems are architected — modules, configurations, customizations, and integrations — well enough to challenge scope, catch risks early, and make informed prioritization decisions.
* Be conversational with developers about APIs, data flows, integrations, and technical constraints. You don't write code, but you understand what is easy vs. complex, and why.
* Read and contribute to technical specs, review configurations with engineers, and ensure business requirements are accurately translated before development starts.
* Identify technical debt, performance issues, or architectural risks in the ERP footprint and flag them proactively with the engineering team.
* Define and track adoption and utilization KPIs per module (active users, transactions captured in\-system vs. outside, automation rate, exception rate, error rate, days\-to\-close, etc.).
* Build enablement materials, SOPs, training, and runbooks for finance users — ensure that what we deliver is actually used.
* Monitor usage data, surface adoption blockers, and run targeted interventions (training refreshers, UX tweaks, configuration changes) to lift utilization.
* Be the dedicated ERP–Finance partner to the Finance leadership team and their team members.
* Translate finance language into technical requirements and engineering language into business\-readable updates.
* Run a regular operating rhythm with Finance: weekly working sessions, monthly steering, quarterly roadmap reviews.
* Ensure the ERP is the single source of truth for finance data — and that reports, dashboards, and reconciliations pull from it correctly.
* Partner with Finance and Internal Audit on access controls, segregation of duties, audit trails, and compliance configurations within the ERP.
* Support month\-end and year\-end close by removing system blockers and ensuring data integrity.
* Maintain comprehensive, up\-to\-date documentation of the ERP–Finance footprint: configurations, customizations, integrations, workflows, and decisions made.
* Contribute to the team's knowledge base (Notion, Confluence) so the role and the system are not dependent on any single individual.
* Onboard new finance users with a structured curriculum and reference materials.


**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**

* Proven track record of managing end\-to\-end projects: scope definition, stakeholder alignment, delivery, UAT, go\-live, and outcome measurement.
* Strong functional knowledge of finance and accounting concepts: GL, AP, AR, fixed assets, multi\-currency, multi\-company, intercompany, tax, reconciliation, and financial close.
* Demonstrated experience identifying ERP gaps, scoping improvements, leading delivery, and driving adoption with finance teams.
* Solid technical literacy — comfortable reading system specs, understanding integrations, APIs, and data flows, reviewing configurations with engineers, and making informed scope and priority decisions.
* Strong product\-owner / business\-analyst skill set — discovery, requirements documentation, user stories, UAT, success measurement.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to push back constructively and align senior finance and tech leaders.
* Working proficiency with Jira, Notion, Miro, and basic productivity tools.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems — particularly the Accounting, Invoicing, Payments, Reporting modules, etc.
* Experience with ERP version migrations or upgrades on live systems.
* Exposure to high\-growth, multi\-entity, multi\-currency environments — ideally in tech, e\-commerce, fintech, or super\-app companies.
* Familiarity with payment gateway integrations, bank connectors, and reconciliation automation.
* Experience working embedded in or alongside a software engineering team — understanding the development lifecycle, sprint ceremonies, and technical trade\-offs.
* Process improvement background (Lean / Six Sigma / Agile).


**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; an MBA or equivalent is welcome.
* CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent finance certification.
* PMP, Agile, or product management certifications.

**Description**
**About the role**
 Qatar Airways are pleased to announce an incredibly exciting opportunity to join our Distribution team as a Commercial Efficiency Manager (Payments) to be based in Doha, Qatar.
   

  

 As a Commercial Efficiency Manager (Payments), you will own the commercial payment strategy and operational framework for Qatar Airways' indirect distribution channels; ensuring that payment method acceptance, cost of sale management, policy governance, and payment programme performance across indirect channels are delivered with commercial discipline and measurable efficiency. You will also be responsible for developing and maintaining the indirect channel payment roadmap, driving the adoption of preferred payment methods, monitoring payment\-related costs, and ensuring that all payment policies and processes across indirect channels are clearly defined, consistently enforced, and continuously improved. In this role you will work in close coordination with the Manager Payments for the direct channel and the Head of Payments in Finance to maintain a coherent, cross\-channel view of Qatar Airways' payment economics, while holding clear primary ownership of the indirect channel.
   

  

**Specific Responsibilities For The Role Include**
* Define and maintain the indirect channel payment strategy by establishing Qatar Airways' commercial position on payment method acceptance, preferred payment method prioritisation, cost of sale targets, and payment policy frameworks across GDS, NDC, aggregator, and other indirect connect channels; ensuring alignment with the broader commercial direction.
* Develop and own the indirect channel payment roadmap by identifying, prioritizing, and sequencing payment capability improvements, new payment method introductions, and legacy method rationalization across indirect channels; grounded in sound business cases with clear commercial outcomes, measurable ROI, and realistic delivery timelines, in full coordination with market and segment owners.
* Monitor and manage Qatar Airways' payment cost of sale across indirect channels on a continuous basis by tracking payment method costs, acquirer fees, scheme charges, and processing costs by channel and market; producing regular, accurate reporting that gives the Commercial and Finance teams a clear view of payment economics, cost trends, and variance against target.
* Drive the adoption of preferred and lower\-cost payment methods across indirect channels by working with trade partners, distribution partners, and channel owners to actively shift the payment mix towards methods that improve Qatar Airways' net revenue position and reduce distribution cost of sale over time.
* Own and maintain the indirect channel payment policy framework by defining, documenting, and enforcing payment acceptance policies, surcharging rules, local payment method guidelines, and agency payment terms across all indirect distribution channels while ensuring policies are consistently applied across markets and regularly reviewed for commercial relevance and compliance.
* Coordinate and manage business cases for all payment\-related investment and change initiatives; including new payment method implementations, acquirer contract changes, technology upgrades, and cost optimisation programmes while ensuring all proposals are commercially justified, financially modelled, and presented with clear recommendations.
* Coordinate with finance on subjects related to acquirers and payment service providers; supporting contractual reviews, RFP processes, and commercial negotiations while ensuring that acquirer relationships and contract terms reflect Qatar Airways' commercial objectives and cost targets.
* Manage agency payment processes and policy compliance across indirect channels; including agency payment terms, ADM\-related payment disputes, and breach management by ensuring that trade partner payment behaviour is monitored, non\-compliance is addressed promptly, and corrective action is tracked through to resolution.
* Work with Finance on payment fraud prevention and cost protection by coordinating fraud monitoring, recovery mechanism implementation, and payment card fee optimization; ensuring that fraud\-related risks and costs are actively managed and do not erode the commercial efficiency of indirect channel payment operations.
* Support the activation of new destinations and distribution channels from a payment readiness perspective by assessing local payment method requirements, provisioning appropriate payment options, and ensuring payment infrastructure is in place before commercial launch.

Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
 The successful candidate will have the following skills and qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics or related field with minimum 7 years of job\-related experience.
* Experience in payments, commercial strategy, airline distribution, or financial operations within aviation, travel, or e\-commerce environments.
* Proven experience managing payment strategy, cost optimisation, and commercial performance across multiple channels (GDS, NDC, aggregators, or similar ecosystems).
* Experience with financial modelling, dashboards, and performance tracking tools (Excel, Power BI, Tableau).
* Experience building business cases with ROI modelling and financial forecasting.
* Strong knowledge of global payment ecosystems, including card schemes, alternative payment methods, acquirers, PSPs, and settlement processes.
* Deep understanding of payment cost drivers.
* Strong understanding of agency payment flows, settlement processes, and industry standards.

* Strong commercial acumen with ability to drive payment method adoption strategies.

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that Country’s Corporate Bank Business is optimally managed with the appropriate levels of co\-ordination between the constituent parts of the unit. This includes ensuring that, revenue potential is realized in a cost effective, low risk manner. The target client portfolio is developed in line with QNB’s stated strategic intent and, maximum revenue potential of relationship officers is realized via effective coaching, training and communication.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective departmental/ unit heads and monitor exercise of the same
* Implement the bank’s approved strategy / plan to facilitate achievement of related short and long term business goals in the most effective and efficient manner.
* Oversee the development and subsequent implementation of annual plans by the individual departments / functions comprising Corporate Banking to ensure achievement of pre\-set targets / objectives, including but not limited to business growth and expansion.
* Approve / amend Key Performance Indicators for the purpose of performance monitoring and quality measurement of the Corporate Banking Division and systematic monitoring of their achievements in terms of assets and liabilities.
* Manage the development and subsequent implementation of market best practices across all activities / operations comprising the Corporate and Institution Banking Department to promote efficiencies in work processes, ultimately resulting in increased customer satisfaction.
* Review / analyse the Corporate and Institution Banking Department management accounts (comprising the balance sheet, income statement along with the budgeted figures) on a monthly basis and positively address adverse variances noted with the respective departmental / function heads.
* Observes and promotes cost consciousness and efficiency, and enhance productivity, to minimize costs, avoid wastes, and optimize benefits for the bank
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Ensure the provision of value added corporate products and services to existing / potential corporate banking customers who seek banking relationships with the bank.
* Endeavour to enhance, maintain and deepen relationships with existing corporate customer base, as well as building new relationships. Ensure, by monitoring the performance of the country FI / GSF / GTB resource, that the FI customer base is developed in accordance with approved country/regional strategy for FI’s / GTB and GSF.
* Oversee the implementation and constant enhancement of the overall customer service culture within Corporate Banking team.
* Approve Service Level Agreements with other branch divisions/ departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time, which will also help increase external customer satisfaction.
* Maintain and enhance relationships with Central Bank / other regulators and professional firms as appropriate. Ensure the promotion of QNB’s footprint and product and service offering through professional and other relevant forums.
* Support the local development of GAM accounts where appropriate.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.

data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is a greenfield central securities depository being built to go\-live in 2027\.
 



  





 We are hiring a Head of Product Technology to own the technology platform end\-to\-end: the application and the infrastructure on which it runs. This is not background plumbing. The application is the product. The infrastructure is the foundation on which settlement finality, system resilience, latency performance, and operational availability are delivered. The post\-holder must understand both layers as one integrated whole and own them as one.
 



  





 In Build, the post\-holder is the architect of the platform from a blank sheet: technology reference architecture, infrastructure topology, hosting strategy, network and database design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and disaster\-recovery architecture. In Run, the same person operates the platform and the team they have designed. This is not a sit\-in\-your\-office role.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Designing the technology reference architecture from a blank sheet: application architecture, infrastructure topology, database platform, network design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and DR architecture
* Owning the application end\-to\-end: design, configuration, integration, data model, change management, and support
* Owning the infrastructure that hosts the platform: compute, storage, network, virtualisation, database, and middleware, whether on\-premise, hosted, or cloud
* Owning platform resilience: high availability design, backup and recovery architecture, disaster recovery, business continuity, and tested failover
* Owning end\-to\-end platform performance including transaction latency, capacity planning, and headroom strategy
* Owning first\-line platform security: secure configuration, hardening, identity and access management, vulnerability management, patching, and security incident response
* Owning the technical relationship with the build vendor; holding them to account on functional, technical, and operational delivery
* Designing the human operating model for the platform: team shape, shift patterns, on\-call rotations, incident command structure, runbooks, and third\-party support arrangements
* Owning all integrations between the platform and external systems: custodians, settlement banks, exchange, SWIFT, Bloomberg, and ISIN infrastructure
* Line managing the Application Managers, Database Administrator, and the wider platform engineering team as it builds



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 12 years in financial\-services platform technology, with substantial time spent owning a mission\-critical platform end\-to\-end across both application and infrastructure layers. Direct, demonstrable experience architecting a mission\-critical regulated financial platform from a blank sheet: this is non\-negotiable. Direct, demonstrable experience as the technical authority on a CSD, custody platform, post\-trade platform, capital markets platform, or core banking system of comparable mission\-criticality: also non\-negotiable.
 



  





 Hands\-on technical credibility across both application and infrastructure layers: able to read code, query a database, design a network topology, debug an integration, and challenge a vendor's technical decisions with authority. Demonstrated experience holding a major build vendor or system integrator to account on technical delivery. Deep understanding of how a regulated financial\-services business works, not just the technology underneath it. Fluent in English.

**Description**
**About the role**
 Qatar Airways are pleased to announce an incredibly exciting opportunity to join our Distribution team as a Manager Distribution Technology \& Integration to be based in Doha, Qatar.
   

  

 As a Manager Distribution Technology \& Integration, you will own and operate Qatar Airways' distribution technology infrastructure by ensuring that the full connectivity stack across GDS (EDIFACT), NDC API (Oryx Connect), direct API, and aggregator integrations is stable, performant, and continuously evolved to meet the airline's commercial distribution requirements. You will be accountable for the technical roadmap that governs how Qatar Airways connects to, and is accessible through, every distribution channel \- spanning both shopping and servicing capabilities. You will act as the senior technical authority within the distribution function, translating commercial distribution strategy and partner agreements into precise technical requirements, managing delivery in partnership with IT, and ensuring that every channel integration is built, maintained, and decommissioned in line with QR's distribution objectives. You will work in close coordination with the Manager Distribution Partnerships \& Enablement to bridge the gap between what is agreed commercially and what is delivered technically.
   

  

**Specific Responsibilities For The Role Include**
* Own and maintain the distribution technology roadmap by defining the prioritized pipeline of technical integration projects, connectivity enhancements, and legacy decommissioning initiatives across all distribution channels, and ensuring the roadmap reflects the commercial priorities set by the Senior Manager Distribution and VP.
* Set the technical standards and integration architecture for Qatar Airways' distribution connectivity; establishing the frameworks, protocols, and quality benchmarks that govern how QR connects to GDS, NDC, direct API, and aggregator platforms across both shopping and servicing flows.
* Serve as the senior technical authority for all distribution platform decisions — evaluating new connectivity solutions, assessing build\-vs\-buy options, and providing expert recommendations to the Senior Manager Distribution on the technical implications of distribution strategy choices.
* Drive the technical evolution of Qatar Airways' NDC capability by working with IT and external NDC partners to expand functional coverage, improve stability, and accelerate the adoption of NDC across the distribution partner ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the connectivity stack by building the business case for rationalisation and managing the transition to modern, lower\-cost, higher\-capability integration architectures.
* Oversee the day\-to\-day performance and stability of all distribution platform integrations by monitoring connectivity health across GDS, NDC, direct API, and aggregator channels, ensuring issues are identified proactively, resolved rapidly, and root\-caused to prevent recurrence.
* Manage the technical delivery of all distribution integration projects from requirements definition and IT engagement through build, testing, go\-live, and post\-implementation review to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the technical standards required for production deployment.
* Translate commercial distribution requirements from the Manager Distribution Partnerships \& Enablement into precise technical specifications to ensure that partner onboarding, NDC enablement, and direct connect implementations are scoped accurately and delivered to the agreed commercial timeline.
* Ensure full shopping and servicing coverage across all active distribution channels by tracking capability gaps, prioritising their resolution in the technical roadmap, and working with IT to close coverage deficiencies that impact booking quality, servicing efficiency, or distribution cost.
* Govern distribution platform changes and release management by ensuring all technical changes to the distribution connectivity stack are properly tested, approved, and communicated to relevant internal and external stakeholders before deployment.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation for all distribution integrations; including connectivity specifications, API documentation, integration maps, and decommissioning plans while ensuring the distribution technology estate is well\-understood and auditable at all times.


**Be part of an extraordinary story**
 Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future, and build the life you want while being part of an international community. Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
 The successful candidate will have the following skills and qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field with minimum 9 years of job\-related experience.
* Experience in airline distribution, travel technology, or commercial IT environments.
* Proven experience managing GDS, NDC APIs, and airline distribution platforms.
* Hands\-on experience in Airline reservation systems, Distribution connectivity, NDC implementations and API ecosystems.
* Experience in agile and hybrid delivery models.
* Strong understanding of airline commercial distribution models and cost structures.
* Strong track record of delivering complex integration projects end\-to\-end.
* Strong ability to translate commercial requirements to technical specifications.
* Ability to design and govern end\-to\-end connectivity architecture.
* Ability to build business cases for technology investments and identify cost\-saving and efficiency opportunities.
* Excellent command of spoken and written English.


**About Qatar Airways Group**
 Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. So whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries, and be part of a truly global community.

A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. We are hiring an IT Operations Officer to own the corporate IT environment: end\-user devices, productivity systems, identity management, IT support, and corporate cybersecurity hygiene.
 



  





 This role covers corporate IT only. Production technology systems sit separately with the technology leadership team
 **.** 




  





**What the role covers** 



* Procurement, configuration, and lifecycle management of laptops, peripherals, and mobile devices; maintaining the device inventory and asset register
* Administering the productivity suite (M365 or equivalent) including mailboxes, file storage, collaboration tools, and licensing
* Identity and access management: account provisioning, role\-based access, multi\-factor authentication, and the joiner\-mover\-leaver process
* First\-line IT support for staff: incident triage, resolution, and escalation to the outsourced managed service provider where needed
* Applying cybersecurity policy to corporate systems: email security, endpoint protection, patching, and security awareness training
* Managing corporate IT vendor relationships, service contracts, and the IT contract register



  





  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least five years in an IT operations, IT administration, or end\-user computing role. Demonstrated experience administering M365 or equivalent productivity suites. Working knowledge of identity management, MDM, and endpoint security. Fluent in English; working Arabic preferred. Microsoft, CompTIA, or equivalent certifications are an advantage. So is familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001\) and prior experience in a small\-firm or regulated environment.
 



  





**What this is** 




 This is a founding\-team role. The corporate IT environment is being built now, and the person in this role will set it up properly from the start. If you are self\-sufficient, security\-conscious, and want to own your environment rather than operate within one someone else built, this is worth a conversation.

* Drive pricing discipline, job profitability, vendor cost control, and operational efficiency to improve gross margin and EBIT performance.
* Ensure strong financial leadership across the business through timely and accurate billing, reduction of revenue leakage, disciplined credit control, proactive collections follow\-up, and close monitoring of overdue receivables and cash conversion.

 · Routine Troubleshooting: Provide first\-line fixes for basic issues such as password resets, account unlocking, software installation, or routine IT application support.
 



 · Documentation \& Reporting: Prepare daily/weekly reports on operational metrics, process documentation (e.g., invoices, bills of lading), and maintain accurate filing systems.
 



 · Escalation: Route complex or unresolved problems to L2/L3 technical teams or managers.
 



 · Vendor/Internal Coordination: Coordinate with internal departments or external vendors to process orders, manage inventory, or request support.
 



 · System Monitoring: Monitor application health or server alerts to identify potential bottlenecks or failures.

**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Manager, Data Domain and Products is accountable for governing, coordinating, and enabling a portfolio of data domains and their associated data products, rather than owning a single domain directly.
   

  

 The role ensures that domain data owners (Principal Specialists) operate within a consistent enterprise framework for data products, governance, quality, and value realization. It acts as the portfolio‑level authority, aligning domain priorities with enterprise strategy, resolving cross‑domain conflicts, and ensuring that data products are delivered as reusable, governed assets rather than siloed solutions.
   

  

 This role is responsible for how data domains operate together, how data products are prioritized and standardized, and how domain outputs collectively support enterprise reporting, operations, controls, and decision‑making.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide leadership and oversight across multiple data domains, each owned by a designated domain owner
* Ensure domain owners apply consistent principles for data ownership, stewardship, modeling, quality, and governance.
* Balance demand across domains by prioritizing data products based on enterprise value, regulatory need, and readiness.
* Ensure domain data products integrate cleanly with enterprise platforms and downstream consumers.
* Act as the primary business‑facing interface for enterprise data domains, translating strategic needs into coordinated domain roadmaps.
* Enable domain owners to focus on execution by removing blockers, resolving dependencies, and clarifying priorities.
* Ensure lifecycle artifacts (ownership, definitions, quality expectations, refresh SLAs) are consistently produced across domains.
* Lead and develop domain owners, ensuring clarity of role boundaries between domain ownership and enterprise oversight.


**Minimum Qualification, Experience And Competencies**
**Minimum Qualification**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, or related field.
* MBA or Master’s degree or equivalent professional experience is an advantage.


**Minimum Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience across data, analytics, or enterprise information management
* Proven experience leading multiple data domains or portfolios, not just a single domain
* Demonstrated ability to manage senior specialists and influence cross‑functional stakeholders


**Skills**
* Portfolio‑level data domain and product management
* Enterprise data governance and operating models
* Cross‑domain KPI and semantic alignment
* Stakeholder management at senior business and technical levels
* Ability to translate strategy into coordinated execution across multiple owners

 The CISO will provide independent executive leadership and oversight across cybersecurity governance, risk management, and security operations. The role requires a pragmatic, business\-oriented leader with strong expertise in cybersecurity, cloud security, and modern technology environments, capable of ensuring that cybersecurity risks are identified, managed, and reported in alignment with the organization's risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

 \- Ensure cybersecurity considerations are embedded into corporate governance and enterprise risk management.

 \- Own and oversee the cybersecurity risk management framework.

 \- Ensure timely remediation of audit findings and regulatory observations.

The Chief Information Officer will define and execute the technology strategy across infrastructure, enterprise applications, data, integration, and security, and will be accountable for the reliability, security, and commercial relevance of the entire technology estate.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring a clear point of view on the future state of enterprise technology, the right balance between in\-house capability and strategic partners, and the discipline to deliver value in quarters rather than years.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**

* Embed data\-led decision\-making across the senior leadership population.
* Hold full accountability for the cybersecurity posture of the company.
* Ensure full compliance with the National Cybersecurity Authority, the Personal Data Protection Law, and all other applicable regulatory obligations.
* Own business continuity, disaster recovery, and the controls required by internal and external audit.
* Run a service\-oriented IT operation with measurable uptime, response, and cost commitments.
* Lead the program management office for technology, with clear quarterly delivery, transparent governance, and disciplined vendor management.
* Shape the IT operating model, including the balance between in\-house capability, managed services, and strategic partners.
* Sit on the executive committee and act as a peer to the rest of the senior leadership.
* Translate technology into commercial language for the Chief Executive Officer and the board.
* Manage the technology budget with the same rigor as a P\&L, including capital allocation, vendor consolidation, and total cost of ownership.

***About Odontyn***




 Odontyn is a market place and dental practice\-management platform used by clinics, dentists, and their patients. It covers clinical records, appointments, billing, imaging, telehealth, and integration with external health systems. The product is already in production, and we're actively building on it.
 



  





***The role***




 We're hiring one experienced full\-stack developer to own Odontyn outright: the Laravel
 



 backend, the React frontend, and the AWS infrastructure it runs on. You'd be the only developer on the product. You work directly with the founder, who sets product direction, but how the system is built and how it runs is yours to decide. It's a good fit if you've owned a production system on your own before. You should be steady at shipping, confident making technical decisions, and comfortable working without close oversight.
 



  





***Tech stack***



* **Backend:** 
  PHP 8\.3, Laravel 12, Filament v4, MySQL/MariaDB, Laravel Reverb (websockets)
* **Frontend:** 
  TypeScript, React 19, Vite, TanStack Router and Query, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
* **Infrastructure:** 
  AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, KMS), Stripe billing
* **Integrations:** 
  HL7 / NABIDH health\-system interoperability, real\-time updates, OpenAI, Deepgram, cloud.



  





***What you'll do***



* Maintain and extend the Laravel API (around 100 data models and 490 endpoints) and the role\-based React single\-page app.
* Build new features end to end, mostly small to medium, with some larger ones.
* Own the AWS side: deployments, EC2/RDS/S3, and setting up a proper CI/CD pipeline, since there isn't one yet.
* Keep production healthy: queue workers, websockets, billing, and monitoring.
* Improve test coverage and code quality as you go.
* Work closely with the founder on priorities and delivery.



  





***What we need***



* 5\+ years of professional full\-stack development experience.
* Strong PHP and Laravel: Eloquent, queues, events, and service\-layer architecture.
* Strong TypeScript and React with modern tooling (Vite, TanStack, component libraries).
* Solid REST API design and relational database skills (MySQL/MariaDB).
* Hands\-on AWS: comfortable owning EC2, RDS, and S3, and building deployment pipelines.
* Able to work independently and take full ownership of a live system.
* Good spoken English, and availability for regular calls and sync\-ups.



  





***Nice to have***



* Experience with the Filament admin framework.
* Healthcare interoperability (HL7, NABIDH) or other regulated\-industry experience.
* Privacy and compliance engineering: consent flows, audit trails, HIPAA or GDPR.
* Stripe billing and real\-time or websocket systems.
* Arabic or RTL internationalization.
* A strong testing habit, especially raising coverage on an under\-tested codebase.



  





***The details***



* Full\-time and fully remote.
* Start date: as soon as possible.
* Some overlap with Kuwait hours (GMT\+3\) is a plus; otherwise flexible, as long as you're reachable for regular calls.
* Compensation: 300–400 KWD per month, depending on experience
* Deadline to submit the application: 12th of June 2026 at 12pm
 
 (GMT\+3\).

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The team**
 This group operates as a
 **startup within Careem** 
 with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a
 **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer \- WorkOS \- Enterprise Agentic AI** 
 to be the vanguard of the WorkOS mission. This is a role for a "heretic": someone who cares more about solving the problem and delivering value than following a rigid spec. You will be the bridge between our core AI engine and the messy, high\-stakes reality of our customers’ operations.
   

  

 As an FDE, you aren't sitting in the back office; you are on the front lines, embedded with internal Careem verticals and external enterprise partners. In partnership with your implementation squad, consisting also of business transformation consultants, you will identify their deepest friction points and build the "special ops" code that proves the power of WorkOS. Your work is the proof of concept that will redefine how the region works.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Tip of the Spear: Lead the deployment of WorkOS in the field. You will be responsible for understanding a customer's operational "chaos" and architecting an AI\-driven solution that fixes it in weeks, not months.
* Rapid\-Fire Execution: Build, iterate, and ship. You will write high\-quality, full\-stack code to create bespoke integrations and augment our platform’s core capabilities and create custom agents. This goes beyond context engineering; you’ll build the connective tissue \- integrating bespoke APIs, setting up RAGs and Evals, tuning the E2E system and performance, and architecting multi\-agent handoffs.
* Feedback Loop Mastery: You are the eyes and ears of the product team. You will translate field\-tested insights into core product requirements, ensuring WorkOS remains grounded in real\-world utility.
* Winning Stakeholders: Act as the technical face of WorkOS. You’ll need to win the trust of stakeholders, navigate complex enterprise hierarchies, and persuade skeptics by shipping results that speak for themselves.
* Technical Versatility: One day you’re setting up a RAG pipeline; the next, you’re debugging a legacy enterprise API or designing a custom dashboard. You do whatever is necessary to make the solution land.


**What You’ll Need**
* 5–8\+ years of high\-octane engineering experience. You are likely a senior\-level engineer who is "hungrier" than your peers and bored by traditional, slow\-moving dev cycles.
* The FDE Pedigree: Experience in forward\-deployed, mission\-driven environments (e.g., Palantir, high\-growth startups, or specialized consultancy) where you worked directly with customers.
* Full\-Stack Polyglot: Mastery of the modern stack (React/TS, Python/Node) with the ability to jump into any codebase and be productive on day one.
* AI Fluidity: Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks. You don't just know the theory; you know how to make AI work in production.
* Excellent Communication: You are a "social engineer." You can explain complex AI logic to a CEO and then pivot to a deep\-dive session with an infrastructure lead without missing a beat.
* Relentless Bias for Action: You are a builder who values shipping over perfection. You have a "founder\-level" sense of ownership and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, with occasional travel to be embedded with regional partners.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* A Special Ops Mission: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on winning the customer and solving "unsolvable" problems.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

****Job Description****
**Role Summary**
 Own and accelerate growth for talabat Bahrain across Food (Restaurants) and Q\-Commerce (QC) by driving ROI\-positive campaigns, an always\-on seasonal calendar, and best\-in\-class lifecycle marketing. You’ll grow MAU, acquire and reactivate users, and generate demand through sharp customer segmentation, data\-driven CRM, and performance marketing—while coaching a high\-performing team.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Campaigns \& Seasonal Calendar
+ Plan and execute the Food \& QC annual seasonal calendar (Ramadan, Back\-to\-School, National Days, sports moments, etc.) with clear hypotheses, budgets, and ROI targets.
+ Build campaign playbooks and A/B tests (offers, creatives, channels, landing flows) to improve conversion and basket size.

* ROI \& Performance Management
+ Own channel mix, budgets, and forecasts across paid, owned, and earned; optimize for ROAS, CAC, LTV, payback period, and voucher efficiency.
+ Implement rigorous post\-mortems and incrementality measurement (geo\-tests, holdouts).

* Customer Segmentation
+ Define actionable segments (new, dormant, high\-value, category explorers, QC\-first, etc.) and design journeys to improve activation, frequency, and retention.
+ Partner with Analytics to build cohorts and propensity models for upsell/cross\-sell (e.g., Food → QC).

* CRM / Lifecycle Marketing
+ Own CRM strategy and execution (push, in\-app, email, SMS, WhatsApp), including journey orchestration, triggers, and personalization.
+ Manage creative/offer testing and guardrails (fatigue, opt\-outs, send time).

* MAU Growth \& User Acquisition
+ Scale app installs and re\-installs via performance channels (Meta, Google UAC, TikTok, Snap), OEM/app stores, affiliates, and partnerships.
+ Align paid with ASO and on\-site conversion optimizations to lift install\-to\-order rates.

* Demand Generation
+ Launch category and merchant\-led programs (new store launches, exclusives, bundles, subscriptions) to stimulate orders and GMV.
+ Collaborate with Sales, tMart, and Local Stores to match demand spikes with supply and last\-mile readiness.

* Team Leadership
+ Lead, coach, and develop 2 Senior Specialists.

* Compliance \& Brand
+ Ensure data privacy, consent management, and anti\-spam compliance; uphold brand guidelines and safety standards.


****Qualifications****
**Success Metrics (KPIs)**
* MAU growth and orders per MAU
* New user and reactivation volume; CAC \& CAC payback
* Retention \& frequency (D7/D30 reorder rate, cohort survival)
* ROAS/ROI by channel and campaign; voucher efficiency
* CRM open/CTR, conversion, churn/opt\-out rate, uplift vs. control
* GMV, AOV, and category mix (Food vs. QC)
* Attribution \& tracking health (match rates, data completeness)


****Qualifications****
* 5–8 years in growth/performance marketing or CRM/lifecycle for a consumer app/marketplace (food delivery, q\-commerce, ride\-hailing, or e\-commerce preferred).
* Proven ownership of MAU, CAC/LTV, and retention with strong ROI outcomes.
* Experience building and leading small, high\-impact teams.
* Experience in MENA region


****Skills \& Tools****
* Strong quantitative skills; comfortable with funnel analytics, cohorting, and experimentation.

 Be part of something exceptional. Be part of our team.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and results\-driven Director of Sales \& Marketing to lead the pre\-opening and launch of all sales, marketing, and business development initiatives at Tivoli Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort and Avani Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort.
   

  





 This senior leadership role is responsible for building the brand presence, driving revenue growth, and establishing strong market positioning for both resorts from day one. You will play a key role in creating strategies that align with the luxury and lifestyle positioning of Tivoli and Avani, respectively.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead all pre\-opening Sales \& Marketing planning, including brand positioning, market analysis, promotional strategies, and go\-to\-market campaigns.

* Plan and execute pre\-opening events, soft openings, and launch campaigns to maximize media coverage and brand exposure.
* Ensure all sales and marketing initiatives adhere to brand standards and positioning of both Tivoli and Avani.
